https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/l.summary: • FG plans investment ombudsman as Nigeria attracts $23bn in capital The Lagos Multi-Door Courthouse has facilitated the settlement or recovery of N86.8bn over five years, highlighting the economic importance of alternative dispute resolution (ADR) in unlocking funds tied up in commercial disputes and strengthening investor confidence.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/l.summary_zh: • 联邦政府计划设立投资监察专员，因为尼日利亚吸引了230亿美元的资本 拉各斯多门法院在五年内促成和解或追回了868亿奈拉的资金，突显了替代性争议解决（ADR）在解锁商业纠纷中被束缚的资金以及加强投资者信心方面的经济重要性。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/l.body: • FG plans investment ombudsman as Nigeria attracts $23bn in capital The Lagos Multi-Door Courthouse has facilitated the settlement or recovery of N86.8bn over five years, highlighting the economic importance of alternative dispute resolution (ADR) in unlocking funds tied up in commercial disputes and strengthening investor confidence. The Chief Judge of Lagos State, Justice Kazeem Alogba, disclosed this yesterday at the third annual Multi-Door Courthouses and Alternative Dispute Resolution Stakeholders’ Summit at the MUSON Centre, Lagos. The disclosure came as the federal government revealed that Nigeria attracted $23bn in capital importation in 2025, while its foreign exchange reserves exceeded $50bn. The government also plans to introduce an investment ombudsman mechanism to address investors’ grievances before they escalate into formal disputes. Justice Alogba said the funds recovered through the Lagos Multi-Door Courthouse demonstrated how ADR could return money to productive economic activities that might otherwise be delayed by prolonged litigation. “Those are funds that have been released back into the economy for salaries, suppliers, expansions, and lending. That is what investor confidence looks like in practice,” he said. The chief judge, however, called for faster enforcement of mediated settlements and arbitral awards, warning that the benefits of ADR would be undermined if parties could not rely on agreements being implemented. He urged stakeholders to develop a harmonised practice protocol for multi-door courthouses, strengthen enforcement mechanisms, invest in technology and professional training, and increase public awareness of ADR. He also advocated measurable targets to reduce the time and cost of resolving commercial disputes, noting that the effectiveness of the justice system was critical to building confidence among businesses and investors. The Minister of Industry, Trade and Investment, Dr. Jumoke Oduwole, said Nigeria’s improving economic indicators needed to be supported by a predictable business environment where commercial disputes could be resolved fairly, efficiently and reliably. She disclosed that capital importation grew by 83 per cent year-on-year, rising from $5.5bn in the first quarter of 2025 to more than $10bn in the first quarter of 2026. According to her, the economy grew by more than four per cent in 2025 and sustained growth above that level in the first half of 2026. She added that inflation declined from 33.2 per cent in 2024 to 14.63 per cent in September 2026, while non-oil exports exceeded $6bn. The creative and digital sector, she said, accounted for approximately 18 per cent of Nigeria’s Gross Domestic Product. Despite the positive indicators, Oduwole stressed that sustained investment depended on institutional reliability, regulatory clarity, enforceable contracts and effective mechanisms for resolving commercial disagreements. “Investor confidence is not built by opportunity alone. Investors also consider the reliability and responsiveness of our institutions, the clarity of our regulations, the enforceability of contracts, and their ability to resolve commercial and investment disputes fairly and efficiently,” she said. The minister said the federal government wanted to attract capital into productive sectors, including manufacturing, infrastructure, processing and other enterprises capable of generating employment and expanding economic activity. “A predictable business environment attracts investment; it’s really that simple. Credible institutions sustain it, and effective dispute resolution helps to protect it,” she added. Oduwole said the proposed investment ombudsman mechanism would provide an avenue for addressing investors’ complaints before they developed into formal disputes. She said the initiative aligned with the investment framework under the African Continental Free Trade Area.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/l.title_zh: 拉各斯多门法院在五年内促成868亿奈拉和解
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/l.body_zh: • 联邦政府计划设立投资监察专员，因为尼日利亚吸引了230亿美元资本 拉各斯多门法院在五年内促成和解或追回868亿奈拉资金，这凸显了替代性争议解决机制（ADR）在解锁被商业纠纷冻结资金以及增强投资者信心方面的经济重要性。拉各斯州首席法官卡齐姆·阿洛巴法官昨天在拉各斯MUSON中心举行的第三届年度多门法院和替代性争议解决机制利益相关者峰会上披露了这一信息。这一披露正值联邦政府透露尼日利亚在2025年吸引了230亿美元资本输入，同时其外汇储备超过500亿美元之际。政府还计划引入投资监察专员机制，以在投资者不满升级为正式纠纷之前加以解决。阿洛巴法官表示，通过拉各斯多门法院追回的资金展示了ADR如何将资金重新投入到生产性经济活动中，否则这些资金可能会因旷日持久的诉讼而被延迟。“这些是被释放回经济体中用于支付薪资、供应、扩张和贷款的资金。这就是投资者信心的实际体现，”他说。然而，首席法官呼吁加快对调解和解和仲裁裁决的执行，并警告称，如果各方无法依赖协议得到执行，ADR的好处将被削弱。他敦促利益相关者为多门法院制定统一的实践协议，加强执行机制，投资技术和专业培训，并提高公众对ADR的认识。他还主张设定可衡量的目标，以减少解决商业纠纷的时间和成本，并指出司法系统的有效性对于建立企业和投资者信心至关重要。工业、贸易和投资部长朱莫克·奥杜沃莱博士表示，尼日利亚不断改善的经济指标需要得到可预测的商业环境的支撑，在这种环境中商业纠纷能够得到公平、高效和可靠的解决。她披露，资本输入同比增长83%，从2025年第一季度的55亿美元上升到2026年第一季度的超过100亿美元。据她介绍，经济在2025年增长超过4%，并在2026年上半年维持高于该水平的增长。她补充说，通胀率从2024年的33.2%下降到2026年9月的14.63%，而非石油出口超过60亿美元。她说，创意和数字部门约占尼日利亚国内生产总值的18%。尽管有这些积极指标，奥杜沃莱强调，持续的投资取决于机构的可靠性、监管的清晰性、可执行的合同以及解决商业分歧的有效机制。“投资者信心不仅仅靠机会建立。投资者还会考虑我们机构的可靠性和响应能力、我们监管的清晰度、合同的可执行性，以及他们公平高效解决商业和投资纠纷的能力，”她说。部长表示，联邦政府希望将资本吸引到生产性部门，包括制造业、基础设施、加工和其他能够创造就业和扩大经济活动的企业。“可预测的商业环境吸引投资；道理真的就这么简单。可信的机构维持它，而有效的纠纷解决有助于保护它，”她补充说。奥杜沃莱表示，拟议的投资监察专员机制将为在投资者投诉发展成正式纠纷之前加以解决提供一条途径。她说，这一举措与非洲大陆自由贸易区下的投资框架相一致。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/f.title: FG Unlocks $125 Million Private Investment for Housing Through PPP, Cuts Project Costs By 30%
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/f.summary: •ICRC says model targets 100,000 housing units without direct federal financing of construction Director General/Chief Executive, Infrastructure Concession Regulatory Commission (ICRC), Dr. obson Ewalefoh, said the federal government has deployed concessionary financing, mortgage support and risk-sharing arrangements to unlock about $125 million in private-sector investment for affordable housing, cutting the effective cost of its Renewed Hope Housing project by about 30 per cent.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/f.summary_zh: •国际红十字委员会表示该模式目标是10万套住房单位而无直接联邦建筑融资 基础设施特许经营监管委员会（ICRC）总干事/首席执行官Dr. obson Ewalefoh表示，联邦政府已部署特许融资、抵押支持和风险分担安排，以解锁约1.25亿美元的私营部门投资用于经济适用房，将其Renewed Hope Housing项目的有效成本降低了约30%。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/f.body: •ICRC says model targets 100,000 housing units without direct federal financing of construction Director General/Chief Executive, Infrastructure Concession Regulatory Commission (ICRC), Dr. obson Ewalefoh, said the federal government has deployed concessionary financing, mortgage support and risk-sharing arrangements to unlock about $125 million in private-sector investment for affordable housing, cutting the effective cost of its Renewed Hope Housing project by about 30 per cent. The financing structure, presented at a continental Public-Private Partnership (PPP) forum in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, was designed to deliver 100,000 housing units across selected Nigerian cities without direct government financing of construction. The finaning initiative seeks to address one of the major constraints to housing development in the country including high cost of capital, with commercial lending rates exceeding 23 per cent, making it difficult for developers to finance projects and for prospective homeowners to afford completed units. Under the arrangement, the government is deploying targeted financial incentives, guaranteed demand and supporting infrastructure to reduce investment risks and attract private capital into a sector where high development costs and limited access to affordable mortgages have continued to constrain supply. Ewalefoh, who presented Nigeria’s model at the forum, said the structure differed from conventional PPP arrangements because the private-sector partner was responsible for providing the land, designing the housing scheme, financing construction and executing the project. According to him, government’s intervention is focused on removing the risks that could discourage private investors rather than directly financing the construction of the housing units. He said, “The beauty of this PPP structure is that it is not the conventional PPP. In this case, the private party owns the land, has the design, is financing it and is doing the construction.” The federal government’s commitments include identifying middle-income federal civil servants as off-takers for the homes, providing access roads to the semi-urban project locations and facilitating access to concessionary funding through specialised housing finance institutions. Specifically, about $19 million in single-digit interest-rate funding was unlocked through the Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria, while another $20 million in concessionary loans was provided through the Family Homes Fund. He said the arrangement also incorporated about $112 million from the MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund (MRIF) to support lower mortgage rates for buyers. In addition, sale prices were negotiated with the developer to improve affordability, while a restriction limiting purchases to one housing unit per buyer was introduced to discourage speculative acquisition. The combined measures, according to the ICRC director-general, had reduced the effective cost of the project by about 30 per cent, helping to improve its commercial viability while limiting the government’s direct financing burden. The initiative reflects the current administration’s attempt to use public resources and policy commitments to mobilise private investment in infrastructure, particularly in sectors where affordability concerns limit the extent to which investors can recover their costs directly from end-users. Ewalefoh pointed out that unlike toll roads, ports and power projects, social infrastructure such as housing, healthcare and education often requires additional government support because the revenue generated from users may not be sufficient to cover the cost of investment at commercially viable rates. He told delegates that the government’s role in the Renewed Hope Housing project was therefore to create the conditions necessary for private capital to participate in housing delivery at a lower cost.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/f.title_zh: 联邦政府通过PPP解锁1.25亿美元私人住房投资，将项目成本降低30%
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/f.body_zh: •红十字国际委员会表示，该模式的目标是在没有联邦直接融资建设的情况下提供10万套住房单元 基础设施特许经营监管委员会（ICRC）总干事/首席执行官奥布森·埃瓦莱福博士表示，联邦政府已部署特许融资、抵押贷款支持和风险分担安排，以解锁约1.25亿美元的私营部门投资用于经济适用房，将其“重振希望住房”项目的有效成本降低了约30%。这一融资结构在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴举行的非洲大陆公私合作（PPP）论坛上提出，旨在在尼日利亚选定城市交付10万套住房单元，而无需政府直接融资建设。该融资举措旨在解决该国住房开发的主要制约因素之一，包括资本成本高，商业贷款利率超过23%，这使得开发商难以融资项目，潜在业主也难以负担完工单元。在该安排下，政府正在部署有针对性的财政激励、担保需求和支持性基础设施，以降低投资风险并吸引私人资本进入该部门，而该部门的高开发成本和获得负担得起的抵押贷款的机会有限继续制约供应。在论坛上介绍尼日利亚模式的埃瓦莱福表示，该结构不同于传统的PPP安排，因为私营部门合作伙伴负责提供土地、设计住房方案、融资建设和执行项目。据他说，政府的干预重点是消除可能阻碍私人投资者的风险，而不是直接融资住房单元的建设。他说：“这种PPP结构的优点在于它不是传统的PPP。在这种情况下，私人一方拥有土地、拥有设计、正在为其融资并正在进行建设。”联邦政府的承诺包括确定中等收入联邦公务员作为这些住房的购买者，提供通往半城市项目地点的道路，并通过专门的住房金融机构促进获得特许融资。具体而言，通过尼日利亚联邦抵押贷款银行解锁了约1900万美元的个位数利率资金，而家庭住房基金提供了另外2000万美元的特许贷款。他说，该安排还纳入了来自MOFI房地产投资基金（MRIF）的约1.12亿美元，以支持买家的较低抵押贷款利率。此外，还与开发商谈判了销售价格以提高可负担性，同时引入了限制每位买家只能购买一套住房单元的规定，以阻止投机性收购。据ICRC总干事称，这些综合措施已将项目的有效成本降低了约30%，有助于提高其商业可行性，同时限制了政府的直接融资负担。该举措反映了现任政府试图使用公共资源和政策承诺来动员基础设施领域的私人投资，特别是在负担能力问题限制投资者直接从最终用户收回成本的部门。埃瓦莱福指出，与收费公路、港口和电力项目不同，住房、医疗保健和教育等社会基础设施通常需要额外的政府支持，因为从用户那里产生的收入可能不足以按商业可行利率覆盖投资成本。他告诉代表们，因此，政府在“重振希望住房”项目中的作用是创造必要条件，让私人资本以较低成本参与住房交付。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/j.title: JAMB Declares Varsity Admission Letters Illegal, Says Only CAPS Admission Valid for NYSC
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/j.summary: The Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) has declared that admission letters issued by universities are illegal and invalid. The Board said only the admission letter generated through its Central Admissions Processing System (CAPS) will be recognized for National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) mobilization and other official purposes. Prof. Aina said universities have no statutory power to issue admission letters, adding that JAMB remains the only body empowered by law to do so for all tertiary institutions.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/j.summary_zh: 联合招生与入学委员会（JAMB）已宣布大学发出的录取信是非法的和无效的。该委员会表示，只有通过其中央录取处理系统（CAPS）生成的录取信才会被国家青年服务团（NYSC）动员和其他官方目的认可。艾纳教授表示，大学没有法定权力发出录取信，并补充说JAMB是唯一依法有权为所有高等院校这样做的机构。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/j.body: The Joint Admissions and Matriculation Board (JAMB) has declared that admission letters issued by universities are illegal and invalid. The Board said only the admission letter generated through its Central Admissions Processing System (CAPS) will be recognized for National Youth Service Corps (NYSC) mobilization and other official purposes. Registrar, Prof. Segun Aina, issued the warning on Thursday, 15th October, 2026, when he received a delegation from Veritas University, Abuja, in his office. Prof. Aina said universities have no statutory power to issue admission letters, adding that JAMB remains the only body empowered by law to do so for all tertiary institutions. He charged erring institutions to desist and ensure their candidates obtain the authentic JAMB admission letter after accepting admission on CAPS. He stressed that the Federal Ministry of Education had mandated that all admissions must be conducted through CAPS, and any admission outside the platform is null and void. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.title: NSEG Honours Shinkafi, Cites SMDF’s Mining Investment Drive
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.summary: The Nigerian Society of Economic Geologists (NSEG) has conferred honorary fellowship on the Executive Secretary of the Solid Minerals Development Fund (SMDF), Hajiya Fatima Umaru Shinkafi, alongside two other industry figures, citing her role in attracting investment and advancing Nigeria’s solid minerals sector.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.summary_zh: 尼日利亚经济地质学家协会（NSEG）授予固体矿产发展基金（SMDF）执行秘书Hajiya Fatima Umaru Shinkafi荣誉会士称号，同时还有另外两位行业人物，表彰她在吸引投资和推进尼日利亚固体矿产部门方面的作用。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.body: The Nigerian Society of Economic Geologists (NSEG) has conferred honorary fellowship on the Executive Secretary of the Solid Minerals Development Fund (SMDF), Hajiya Fatima Umaru Shinkafi, alongside two other industry figures, citing her role in attracting investment and advancing Nigeria’s solid minerals sector. In a statement signed by Head of the Corporate Communications Department of the SMDF, Idowu Jokpeyibo, the award was presented at the opening ceremony of NSEG’s 5th Annual International Conference and Exhibition in Kaduna on Monday. The president of NSEG, Prof. Samuel Olobaniyi, said Shinkafi earned the recognition for her contributions to the development of Nigeria’s solid minerals sector. According to the society, Shinkafi repositioned the SMDF as an institutional platform for attracting private capital into Nigeria’s underexplored mining industry, restructuring its investment architecture and establishing a dedicated capital pool for the sector. It added she had assembled a pipeline of projects reflecting the country’s mineral potential and the Fund’s institutional partnerships. NSEG also highlighted the SMDF’s partnership with the Africa Finance Corporation (AFC), through which the two institutions are jointly developing an alumina refinery expected to contribute $1.2 billion annually to Nigeria’s gross domestic product and generate more than $25 billion in value over the project’s lifecycle. The society also cited the SMDF’s Early-Stage Mineral Exploration and Research Grant Endowment (EMERGE), an initiative designed to provide catalytic funding for early-stage mineral exploration, critical minerals development and research and development. The programme seeks to address financing gaps that often prevent exploration projects from attracting conventional private investment, helping promising ventures progress towards investment readiness. NSEG further highlighted the SMDF’s partnership with the Central Bank of Nigeria in developing and launching the National Gold Purchase Scheme, which it said was fully operational. According to the society, the scheme seeks to formalise artisanal and small-scale gold mining, build sovereign reserves in local currency and establish a transparent, compliant pathway for Nigerian gold to access international markets, while improving environmental, social and governance standards across the supply chain. The other honorary fellowship recipients were Chief Innocent Ezuma, Executive Chairman of Etazuma Mining Industries, and Sir Abu Karofi, an economic geologist and administrator whose public service career in Nigeria’s solid minerals sector spans more than four decades. Ezuma is an industrialist, mining and energy entrepreneur, and philanthropist. He is also recognised as a pioneer of Nigeria’s modern coal industry. Karofi’s contributions to the profession earned him a fellowship of the Nigerian Mining and Geosciences Society (NMGS). He was also conferred with the national honour of Officer of the Order of the Niger (OON) by the Federal Government. In addition to the honorary fellows, NSEG conferred its regular fellowship on seven industry professionals: Kolwole Matthew Ogunbiyi, Director-General of the National Steel Raw Materials Exploration Agency; Hon. Matthew Oyedokun, Vice-President of the Nigerian Mining and Geosciences Society; Tunde Muritala Arisekola, a geoscientist; Silas Yakubu, Vice-President of Kimberlite Africa Exploration Company of Nigeria; Dr. Edwin Ekwo of the Nigerian Geological Survey Agency; Prof. Ezeh Hilary, a fellow of the NMGS; and Prof. Rafiu Babatunde, a COMEG-certified chartered geologist. Olobaniyi commended the recipients and urged them to sustain their contributions to the development of Nigeria’s solid minerals sector. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.title_zh: NSEG表彰辛卡菲，表彰SMDF的矿业投资推动
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.body_zh: 尼日利亚经济地质学家协会（NSEG）授予固体矿产发展基金（SMDF）执行秘书Hajiya Fatima Umaru Shinkafi荣誉会士称号，同时还有另外两位业界人士，表彰她在吸引投资和推进尼日利亚固体矿产部门方面的作用。SMDF企业传播部负责人Idowu Jokpeyibo签署的一份声明称，该奖项于周一在卡杜纳举行的NSEG第五届年度国际会议和展览开幕式上颁发。NSEG主席Samuel Olobaniyi教授表示，Shinkafi因其对尼日利亚固体矿产部门发展的贡献而获得这一认可。据该协会称，Shinkafi将SMDF重新定位为一个机构平台，用于吸引私人资本进入尼日利亚未充分勘探的采矿业，重组其投资架构，并为该部门建立一个专门的资本池。该协会补充说，她已经组建了一系列项目管道，反映了该国的矿产潜力和基金的机构伙伴关系。NSEG还强调了SMDF与非洲金融公司（AFC）的伙伴关系，通过该伙伴关系，两家机构正在共同开发一家氧化铝精炼厂，预计每年为尼日利亚国内生产总值贡献12亿美元，并在项目生命周期内创造超过250亿美元的价值。该协会还提到了SMDF的早期矿产勘探和研究资助捐赠计划（EMERGE），这是一个旨在为早期矿产勘探、关键矿产开发以及研发提供催化资金的举措。该计划旨在解决经常阻碍勘探项目吸引常规私人投资的融资缺口，帮助有前景的风险项目朝着投资准备就绪的方向推进。NSEG进一步强调了SMDF与尼日利亚中央银行的伙伴关系，该伙伴关系用于开发和推出国家黄金收购计划，据称该计划已全面运行。据该协会称，该计划旨在将手工和小规模黄金开采正规化，以本地货币建立主权储备，并为尼日利亚黄金建立一条透明、合规的途径进入国际市场，同时改善供应链各环节的环境、社会和治理标准。其他荣誉会士获得者是Etazuma Mining Industries执行主席Chief Innocent Ezuma，以及经济地质学家和行政人员Sir Abu Karofi，他在尼日利亚固体矿产部门的公共服务职业生涯跨越了四十多年。Ezuma是一位实业家、采矿和能源企业家以及慈善家。他也被认为是尼日利亚现代煤炭工业的先驱。Karofi对该行业的贡献为他赢得了尼日利亚采矿与地球科学协会（NMGS）的会士资格。他还被联邦政府授予国家荣誉尼日尔军官勋章（OON）。除了荣誉会士之外，NSEG还向七位行业专业人士授予了其常规会士称号：国家钢铁原材料勘探局局长Kolwole Matthew Ogunbiyi；尼日利亚采矿与地球科学协会副会长Hon. Matthew Oyedokun；地球科学家Tunde Muritala Arisekola；尼日利亚金伯利岩非洲勘探公司副总裁Silas Yakubu；尼日利亚地质调查局的Dr. Edwin Ekwo；NMGS会士Prof. Ezeh Hilary；以及COMEG认证的特许地质学家Prof. Rafiu Babatunde。Olobaniyi赞扬了获奖者，并敦促他们继续为尼日利亚固体矿产部门的发展做出贡献。THISDAY成立于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都特区和世界各地设有办事处。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/e.body: The National Chairman of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Prof. Nentawe Yilwatda, has charged the Directorate of Intelligence and Security of the APC Presidential Campaign Council (APC-PCC) to ensure the safety of members during the electioneering campaigns. Yilwatda, who was represented by the Deputy National Secretary of the party, Prof. Abdulkarim Kana, gave the charge yesterday in Abuja during the inauguration of the committee. He noted that the subcommittee was the first to convene a meeting and set up its operational substructures ahead of the main campaign council. The chairman noted: “This committee, I think, is the most hero-studded committee of all the committees. And you’ve proven yourselves to be most serious. “It is the first committee to convene this kind of meeting, a gathering in operation of the substructures of the main committee of the campaign council. I think it’s a huge clap for yourselves.” Yilwatda commended members for self-organising even before funding allocations were made to directorates. “Even before the finance committee started to think of how much to allocate to the directorates, you organised yourselves. I must commend you,” he said. The chairman charged the subcommittee on its critical role as campaigns commence, noting that the election is a few days away. Director, Intelligence and Security, Gen. Sarkin Bello (rtd) described the assignment as a national exercise that demanded discipline, sound judgement and commitment to the safety of the principal and the integrity of the democratic process. “Our responsibility is to ensure that the campaign communicates the President’s record, priorities and vision accurately with dignity and with respect to the Nigerian electorate,” Bello said. Minister of Defence and Secretary of the Directorate, Gen. Christopher Musa, said security ws paramount to the success of the campaign, noting that the opposition would use economy and insecurity as campaign issues. He said the return of the president was assured but the Directorate must provide the enabling environment, ensure peaceful campaigns, and work with the Information Directorate to project the President’s achievements, especially against misinformation on social media. “Working as a team is the most critical aspect for us, because if we’re divided, we can’t achieve anything,” Musa said. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/e.title_zh: 确保我们在竞选活动中的安全，伊尔瓦达责成APC情报和安全委员会
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/e.body_zh: 全进步大会党（APC）全国主席恩塔韦·伊尔瓦特达教授已责成APC总统竞选委员会情报与安全局（APC-PCC）确保成员在竞选活动期间的安全。伊尔瓦特达由该党全国副秘书长阿卜杜勒卡里姆·卡纳教授代表，昨天在阿布贾举行的该委员会就职典礼上提出了这一要求。他指出，该小组委员会是第一个召开会议并在主要竞选委员会之前建立其运作子结构的。主席指出：“我认为，这个委员会是所有委员会中最英雄云集的委员会。而且你们已经证明自己是最认真的。“这是第一个召开这种会议的委员会，是竞选委员会主要委员会子结构运作的集会。我认为这是对你们自己的巨大掌声。”伊尔瓦特达赞扬成员们甚至在向各局拨款之前就自我组织。“甚至在财务委员会开始考虑向各局分配多少钱之前，你们就自己组织起来了。我必须赞扬你们，”他说。主席责成该小组委员会在其关键作用上，因为竞选即将开始，并指出选举还有几天就要举行。情报与安全局局长萨尔金·贝洛将军（退役）将这项任务描述为一项需要纪律、明智判断和致力于主要人员安全以及民主进程 integrity 的国家行动。“我们的责任是确保竞选准确、有尊严并尊重尼日利亚选民地传达总统的记录、优先事项和愿景，”贝洛说。国防部长兼该局秘书克里斯托弗·穆萨将军表示，安全对竞选的成功至关重要，并指出反对派将利用经济和不安全作为竞选议题。他说总统的回归是有保证的，但该局必须提供有利的环境，确保和平竞选，并与信息局合作突出总统的成就，特别是针对社交媒体上的错误信息。“作为一个团队工作对我们来说是最关键的方面，因为如果我们分裂，我们就无法取得任何成就，”穆萨说。THISDAY 成立于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都特区和世界各地设有办事处。它是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，可在所有平台上为政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级提供服务，同时作为新思想、文化和技术与有抱负者和千禧一代的交汇点。该报纸是一种公共信托，致力于追求真相和理性，涵盖从突发新闻到政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区以及人与社会交汇点的一系列问题。您可以通过 hello@thisdaylive.com 给我们发邮件或访问我们的联系页面。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/t.title: THE MATH OF INDEPENDENCE
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/t.summary: That is what makes the idea of mental colonialism worth examining as Nigeria marks 66 years of independence. Colonial influence did not survive through one channel, several factors; some created during colonial rule and others expanded after independence account for this phenomenon. At independence, we inherited that extractive architecture where a state designed to control territory and collect revenue, not to serve citizens.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/t.summary_zh: 这就是为什么在尼日利亚迎来独立66周年之际，值得审视精神殖民主义这一理念的原因。殖民影响并非通过单一渠道延续下来；一些在殖民统治时期形成的因素，以及独立后得到扩大的其他因素，共同导致了这一现象。在独立时，我们继承了那种掠夺性架构，即一个旨在控制领土和征收收入、而非服务公民的国家架构。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/t.body: DAMILOLA BAKARE argues against the overwhelming vestiges of colonialism Sixty-six years of owning a flag, a constitution, and a seat at the UN. Yet as a single, amalgamated British territory, Nigeria existed for only 46 years (1914–1960). How does 46 years of colonial setup continue to outlive 66 years of self-rule? Nigeria inherited a 46-year-old colonial system, but we have also had six and a half decades to modify it, replace it, or build something entirely different. That is the real paradox. The flag came down, but the wiring remained. The ideas, incentives and hierarchies did not leave with the British. A mindset does not leave because those who installed it left, it must be deliberately replaced, and no one did that for us in 1960. Colonialism was not just about the District Officers and administrative boundaries, it was also about creating a hierarchy of knowledge, authority, language, culture and values. It taught people, over generations, what should be considered sophisticated and local; what was legitimate and what was informal; what was polished and what was not; what counted as knowledge and what was superstition. Those ideas did not require British officials to remain in Nigeria to survive, they were reproduced by Nigerians themselves. That is what makes the idea of mental colonialism worth examining as Nigeria marks 66 years of independence. We see it every day in the courtroom, where lawyers still wear 17th-century British horsehair wigs and black gowns in 35-degree heat to appear learned. You see it in the civil service, where a three-piece suit in 38-degree Abuja remains the uniform of seriousness, while Kaftan or Isiagu is “casual.” Local entrepreneurs struggle to gain legitimacy in their own market, while imported brands are automatically associated with quality and prestige. The message is consistent: authority must look foreign to be real. To be fair, none of this is explained by colonialism alone, globalisation, class, economic incentives and modern media all play their part. But colonial history helped build the hierarchies through which we still assign value. Skin bleaching is widespread across Africa, with Nigeria recording some of the highest reported rates. The exact figures vary, but the pattern is undeniable. Why does lighter skin command such a premium in a society whose overwhelming majority is Black? The answer is not colonialism alone. Colourism, class, gender expectations, advertising, and modern beauty culture all play a role, but colonialism built the framework for these to grow. We see the same pattern in the world of work. Skilled trades are often viewed as backup plan by graduates rather than professions requiring expertise, certification, and entrepreneurship. Yes, higher pay and growth opportunities sometimes explain these preferences, but do they explain why certain forms of work are considered inherently more prestigious even when they pay less than skilled trades? The problem is not aspiration. It is the hierarchy of aspiration. Colonial influence did not survive through one channel, several factors; some created during colonial rule and others expanded after independence account for this phenomenon. Colonial education was closely connected to the administrative and economic needs of the colonial system. It was built to produce clerks not creators. Overtime, the Nigerian elite learned to equate intelligence with fluency in English, not competence in solving Nigerian problems. We inherited that meanwhile; the objective of education should be to produce Nigerians capable of understanding the world and solving Nigerian problems. Indirect rule preserved chiefs but reduced their legitimacy. They became accountable upward to the Crown, not downward to the people. At independence, we inherited that extractive architecture where a state designed to control territory and collect revenue, not to serve citizens. And that is one of the deepest questions of post-colonial Nigeria.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/t.body_zh: 达米洛拉·巴卡雷反对殖民主义的强大残余。拥有国旗、宪法和联合国席位66年。然而，作为一个单一的、合并的英国领土，尼日利亚仅存在了46年（1914-1960）。46年的殖民安排如何继续超越66年的自治？尼日利亚继承了一个46年的殖民体系，但我们也有六又半个十年来修改它、替换它，或完全建立不同的东西。这才是真正的悖论。国旗降下了，但 wiring 仍然存在。思想、激励和等级制度并没有随英国人离开。心态不会因为安装它的人离开了就离开，它必须被有意替换，而1960年没有人替我们这样做。殖民主义不仅仅是关于地区官员和行政边界，它还包括创造知识、权威、语言、文化和价值观的等级制度。它世代教导人们什么应该被视为精致和本土；什么是合法的什么是非正式的；什么是优雅的什么不是；什么算作知识什么算是迷信。这些想法不需要英国官员留在尼日利亚就能存活，它们由尼日利亚人自己复制。这就是为什么在尼日利亚庆祝独立66年之际，精神殖民主义的想法值得考察的原因。我们每天在法庭上都能看到它，律师们仍然在35度高温下戴着17世纪英国马鬃假发和黑色长袍以显得有学识。你在公务员系统中也能看到它，在38度的阿布贾，三件套西装仍然是严肃的制服，而 Kaftan 或 Isiagu 是“休闲”。本地企业家在自己的市场中努力获得合法性，而进口品牌自动与质量和声望联系在一起。信息是一致的：权威必须看起来是外国的才是真实的。公平地说，这些都不是殖民主义 alone 能解释的，全球化、阶级、经济激励和现代媒体都发挥了作用。但殖民历史帮助建立了我们仍然用来分配价值的等级制度。皮肤漂白在非洲很普遍，尼日利亚记录了一些最高的报告率。确切数字各不相同，但模式是不可否认的。为什么在绝大多数人口是黑人的社会中，较浅的皮肤会如此受欢迎？答案不仅仅是殖民主义。肤色主义、阶级、性别期望、广告和现代美容文化都发挥了作用，但殖民主义为这些的增长建立了框架。我们在工作世界中看到同样的模式。熟练工种往往被毕业生视为备用计划，而不是需要专业知识、认证和创业精神的职业。是的，更高的薪酬和增长机会有时解释了这些偏好，但它们是否解释了为什么某些形式的工作即使薪酬低于熟练工种也被认为本质上更具声望？问题不是抱负。而是抱负的等级制度。殖民影响不是通过一个渠道存活的；几个因素，有些是在殖民统治期间创造的，有些是在独立后扩展的，解释了这种现象。殖民教育与殖民体系的行政和经济需求密切相关。它旨在培养文员而不是创造者。随着时间推移，尼日利亚精英学会将智力等同于英语流利，而不是解决尼日利亚问题的能力。我们同时继承了这一点；教育的目标应该是培养能够理解世界并解决尼日利亚问题的尼日利亚人。间接统治保留了酋长但降低了他们的合法性。他们向上对王室负责，而不是向下对人民负责。在独立时，我们继承了那种榨取性架构，国家旨在控制领土和收集收入，而不是服务公民。而这是后殖民尼日利亚最深刻的问题之一。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.summary: More than three decades after its establishment under Decree No. 15 of 1993 and subsequent amendments, the existence of NAFDAC has not eliminated the threat of substandard and falsified medicines, adulterated foods and potentially hazardous beverages. This contradiction raises a fundamental question that goes beyond the existence of regulatory laws or the visibility of enforcement operations.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.summary_zh: 在根据1993年第15号法令及其后续修正案成立三十多年后，国家食品药品监督管理总局（NAFDAC）的存在并未消除不合格和假冒药品、掺假食品以及潜在危险饮料的威胁。这一矛盾提出了一个超越监管法律存在或执法行动可见性的根本问题。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.body: KALU OKORONKWO urges the regulatory agency to consistently protect the lives of Nigerians The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) was established in 1993 in the aftermath of Nigeria’s devastating 1990 paracetamol syrup poisoning disaster, which was associated with at least 109 child deaths linked to diethylene glycol contamination. Its creation represented a critical institutional intervention intended to strengthen public protection against unsafe medicines and other hazardous consumer products. More than three decades after its establishment under Decree No. 15 of 1993 and subsequent amendments, the existence of NAFDAC has not eliminated the threat of substandard and falsified medicines, adulterated foods and potentially hazardous beverages. This contradiction raises a fundamental question that goes beyond the existence of regulatory laws or the visibility of enforcement operations. How effectively has NAFDAC translated its statutory mandate into tangible protection for human life? The persistence of unsafe products in the marketplace demands an incisive examination of regulatory oversight, enforcement capacity, institutional accountability and the gap between the promise of public protection and the realities confronting Nigerian consumers. NAFDAC’s establishment was an important response to the need for effective regulation of medicines, foods, beverages and other products within its statutory mandate. But creating an agency, however necessary, is not the same as eliminating the problem it was designed to address. Legislation can confer authority, institutions can establish procedures, and regulators can recruit inspectors and acquire laboratory equipment. The ultimate test is whether these mechanisms consistently protect the public. That distinction became painfully clear during the My Pikin teething medicine disaster of 2008–2009. A joint investigation involving Nigerian public-health authorities and international experts identified 57 poisoning cases, with 54 dead, among children aged between one to three years. Investigators detected diethylene glycol contamination in samples of the implicated medicine recovered from patients’ homes and in batches associated with its manufacturer. NAFDAC initiated a recall, and the manufacturing facility was shut down. The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) described the incident as Nigeria’s second and largest diethylene glycol-associated poisoning outbreak since 1990. The tragedy remains especially disturbing because the victims were young children whose caregivers had reason to believe they were administering medicine to relieve discomfort. The product was not merely defective merchandise; it was a substance entrusted with a therapeutic purpose that instead became associated with fatal poisoning. In recent years, concerns about falsified medicines, unwholesome foods and unsafe beverages have continued to expose weaknesses in Nigeria’s product safety environment. Reports of enforcement operations and product seizures point to the scale of the challenge. But the discovery of unsafe products does not, by itself, establish how many people have been harmed or does it prove regulatory negligence in every case. In Lagos, Onitsha, Port Harcourt, Aba, Kano and other commercial cities, the circulation of unwholesome products raises questions about the effectiveness of inspection, surveillance, distribution controls and the enforcement of existing standards. According to figures attributed to NAFDAC’s enforcement operations, products valued at approximately ₦22.73 billion were destroyed between January and August 2026. During the same eight-month period, the agency reportedly recorded 5,542 enforcement activities, conducted 213 raids, documented 821 product-seizure entries, closed or sealed 179 premises and made 52 arrests. It also handled 474 new cases, concluded 295 cases and carried out 22 destruction exercises.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.title_zh: NAFDAC、监管失灵与市场上的毒药
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.body_zh: 卡卢·奥科龙克沃敦促监管机构持续保护尼日利亚人的生命 国家食品药品监督管理总局（NAFDAC）成立于1993年，背景是尼日利亚1990年毁灭性的扑热息痛糖浆中毒灾难，该事件与至少109名儿童死亡有关，这些死亡与二甘醇污染有关。其成立代表着一次关键的制度干预，旨在加强公众对不安全药品和其他危险消费品的保护。在根据1993年第15号法令及其后续修正案成立三十多年后，NAFDAC的存在并未消除不合格和假冒药品、掺假食品以及潜在危险饮料的威胁。这一矛盾提出了一个根本问题，该问题超越了监管法律的存在或执法行动的可见性。NAFDAC如何有效地将其法定使命转化为对人类生命的切实保护？市场上不安全产品的持续存在要求对监管监督、执法能力、机构问责制以及公共保护承诺与尼日利亚消费者所面临现实之间的差距进行深入审查。NAFDAC的成立是对有效监管药品、食品、饮料及其法定职责范围内其他产品的必要回应。但是，创建一个机构无论多么必要，都不等于消除它旨在解决的问题。立法可以赋予权力，机构可以建立程序，监管者可以招聘检查员并获得实验室设备。最终的考验是这些机制是否持续保护公众。这种区别在2008-2009年My Pikin出牙药灾难期间变得尤为清晰。一项涉及尼日利亚公共卫生当局和国际专家的联合调查确定了57例中毒病例，其中54名死亡，受害者为年龄在1至3岁之间的儿童。调查人员在从患者家中回收的涉事药品样本以及与其制造商相关的批次中检测到二甘醇污染。NAFDAC启动了召回，制造工厂被关闭。美国疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）将该事件描述为尼日利亚自1990年以来第二次也是最大的二甘醇相关中毒爆发。这一悲剧尤其令人不安，因为受害者是年幼儿童，他们的照顾者有理由相信他们正在给孩子服用药物以缓解不适。该产品不仅仅是有缺陷的商品；它是一种被寄予治疗目的的物质，却反而与致命中毒相关联。近年来，对假冒药品、不健康食品和不安全饮料的担忧继续暴露尼日利亚产品安全环境的弱点。关于执法行动和产品查封的报告指出了挑战的规模。但是，不安全产品的发现本身并不能确定有多少人受到伤害，也不能证明在每个案件中都存在监管疏忽。在拉各斯、奥尼查、哈科特港、阿巴、卡诺和其他商业城市，不健康产品的流通引发了关于检查、监测、分销控制以及现有标准执行的有效性的问题。根据归因于NAFDAC执法行动的数据，2026年1月至8月期间销毁的产品价值约为₦22.73 billion。在同样的八个月期间，该机构据报告记录了5,542次执法活动，进行了213次突击检查，记录了821次产品查封条目，关闭或封存了179处场所，并进行了52次逮捕。它还处理了474个新案件，结案295个，并开展了22次销毁行动。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/e.body: As the 2027 general election draws nearer, Nigeria’s persistent economic hardship, compounded by rising costs of petrol (PMS) and cooking gas, presents a significant challenge for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and the All Progressives Congress (APC). While the administration may point to its economic reforms and other achievements, it must not underestimate how the daily struggles of ordinary Nigerians could influence the outcome of the election. President Tinubu assumed office in May 2023 at a time when Nigeria faced considerable economic challenges. His administration introduced major reforms, including the removal of the petrol subsidy and changes to the foreign exchange system, arguing that these measures were necessary to address structural weaknesses and establish a more sustainable economy. These reforms have had important fiscal and market implications, but their immediate costs have placed considerable pressure on households and businesses. As the cost of living continues to concern Nigerians, increases in petrol and cooking gas prices threaten to intensify the burden. Higher fuel prices affect transportation, food distribution, production and the cost of providing essential services. Cooking gas price increases also place additional pressure on households already struggling to meet basic needs. The effects are interconnected: when transportation and production costs rise, the prices of goods and services often follow. Although international developments, including tensions arising from the conflict involving the United States and Iran, can influence global energy markets, domestic policies and market conditions also determine how these pressures affect Nigerian consumers. The government should therefore consider temporary, targeted interventions to cushion the impact of external shocks without undermining the broader objectives of economic reform . History offers important lessons about the relationship between public hardship and electoral outcomes. In the United States, economic concerns, particularly the cost of living, contributed to Donald Trump’s return to the presidency in 2024. Although immigration, political identity and other issues also influenced voters, dissatisfaction with the economy featured prominently in the election. Nigeria’s experience is equally instructive. In 2015, President Goodluck Jonathan lost his re-election bid amid widespread concerns about insecurity and the management of national affairs. While these factors did not operate in isolation, the election demonstrated how a government’s perceived inability to address citizens’ most pressing concerns can weaken its electoral support. The lesson is that citizens experiencing prolonged hardship may become receptive to alternative leadership, regardless of the explanations offered by the incumbent government. This can produce what is commonly described as a protest vote: a decision by voters to reject the ruling party to express dissatisfaction with their circumstances or the government’s performance. For the APC, the danger is not necessarily that the opposition may have a superior campaign strategy, but that widespread frustration could become a political force in its own right. Party structures, political alliances and campaign promises matter, but they may prove insufficient if voters believe their living conditions have deteriorated without adequate relief. Ultimately, if the 2027 election will be determined by the free and fair expression of Nigerians’ choices, as promised by the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) it is responsibility of the APC is to earn public confidence through results, not assume that political loyalty will guarantee electoral success. Economic hardship may yet prove more formidable than any opposition campaign. The time to respond is now. Listening to Nigerians, easing avoidable suffering and demonstrating measurable progress would serve both the public interest and the government’s political future.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/e.body_zh: 随着2027年大选日益临近，尼日利亚持续的经济困难，加上汽油（PMS）和烹饪燃气价格不断上涨，给总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布和全体进步大会党（APC）带来了重大挑战。虽然政府可能指出其经济改革和其他成就，但绝不能低估普通尼日利亚人日常挣扎可能如何影响选举结果。蒂努布总统于2023年5月就职，当时尼日利亚面临相当大的经济挑战。他的政府推出了重大改革，包括取消汽油补贴和改变外汇体系，认为这些措施对于解决结构性弱点并建立更可持续的经济是必要的。这些改革产生了重要的财政和市场影响，但其直接成本给家庭和企业带来了相当大的压力。随着生活成本继续困扰尼日利亚人，汽油和烹饪燃气价格上涨威胁要加剧这一负担。更高的燃料价格影响运输、食品配送、生产以及提供基本服务的成本。烹饪燃气价格上涨也给已经在努力满足基本需求的家庭带来额外压力。这些影响是相互关联的：当运输和生产成本上升时，商品和服务价格往往也会随之上涨。虽然国际事态发展，包括涉及美国和伊朗的冲突引发的紧张局势，可能影响全球能源市场，但国内政策和市场条件也决定这些压力如何影响尼日利亚消费者。因此，政府应考虑临时、有针对性的干预措施，以缓冲外部冲击的影响，同时不破坏经济改革的更广泛目标。历史为公众苦难与选举结果之间的关系提供了重要教训。在美国，经济担忧，尤其是生活成本，促成了唐纳德·特朗普在2024年重返总统职位。虽然移民、政治身份和其他问题也影响了选民，但对经济的不满在选举中占据突出地位。尼日利亚的经历同样具有启发性。2015年，古德勒克·乔纳森总统因对不安全问题和国家事务管理的广泛担忧而失去了连任竞选。虽然这些因素并非孤立存在，但选举表明，如果政府被认为无法解决公民最紧迫的关切，就会削弱其选举支持。教训是，经历长期苦难的公民可能会接受替代领导，无论现任政府提供何种解释。这可能产生通常所说的抗议投票：选民决定拒绝执政党，以表达对自身处境或政府表现的不满。对于APC来说，危险不一定是反对党可能拥有更优越的竞选策略，而是广泛的挫败感本身可能成为一股政治力量。政党结构、政治联盟和竞选承诺很重要，但如果选民认为他们的生活条件已经恶化而没有得到充分缓解，这些可能被证明是不够的。最终，如果2027年选举将由尼日利亚人自由和公平表达选择来决定，正如独立国家选举委员会（INEC）所承诺的那样，那么APC的责任是通过成果赢得公众信心，而不是假设政治忠诚将保证选举成功。经济困难可能被证明比任何反对党竞选都更强大。现在是做出回应的时机。倾听尼日利亚人的声音，减轻可以避免的苦难，并展示可衡量的进展，将同时服务于公共利益和政府的政治未来。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/p.title: PUBLIC PROCUREMENT AND INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/p.summary: By pledging to make a strong presentation to the National Economic Council (NEC) on the need for federal and state ministries, departments and agencies (MDAs) to patronise D-PAN vehicles, Sani placed public procurement at the centre of the debate on industrial development. Government procurement can be an important instrument of industrial policy. Public procurement should consider price, quality, safety, durability, after-sales support, maintenance costs and value for money.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/p.summary_zh: 通过承诺向国家经济委员会（NEC）就联邦和州部委、部门和机构（MDAs）需要惠顾D-PAN车辆的问题做出强有力的陈述，Sani将公共采购置于工业发展辩论的中心。政府采购可以成为工业政策的重要工具。公共采购应考虑价格、质量、安全、耐用性、售后支持、维护成本和物有所值。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/p.body: Uba Sani pushes for government patronage of Made-in-Nigeria Vehicles, writes KABIR DANJUMA When Governor Uba Sani unveiled the 2026 Peugeot 5008 at the Dangote Peugeot Automobile Nigeria (D-PAN) Limited factory in Kaduna, the event represented more than the introduction of a new vehicle model. It offered an opportunity to renew an important conversation about Nigeria’s industrial future: how government patronage can help sustain local manufacturing, create jobs and turn domestic production into a driver of economic growth. The governor’s message was direct. Nigerian governments should do more than celebrate locally manufactured products; they should create practical demand for them. By pledging to make a strong presentation to the National Economic Council (NEC) on the need for federal and state ministries, departments and agencies (MDAs) to patronise D-PAN vehicles, Sani placed public procurement at the centre of the debate on industrial development. He also pledged that Kaduna State would order some of the vehicles, declaring that his administration intended to lead by example. The proposal raises a fundamental question for Nigeria’s manufacturing sector: what happens when the government becomes an active customer of the industries it hopes to grow? The Peugeot 5008 unveiling provided a platform for the governor to underscore the economic importance of the automobile assembly plant to Kaduna State. Sani commended Alhaji Aliko Dangote for what he described as patriotism through sustained investment in Nigeria. He noted that D-PAN had created jobs, helped address skills gaps and stimulated economic activity within its immediate environment and across the state. These contributions illustrate why manufacturing matters beyond the factory floor. An operating industrial plant creates demand for workers, technical expertise, logistics, maintenance, supplies and other supporting services. Its economic influence can extend into surrounding communities, where businesses and households benefit from the spending generated by industrial activity. For Kaduna, strengthening such an enterprise offers an opportunity to deepen the state’s industrial base while creating pathways for residents to participate in productive economic activity. But industrial investment also requires a dependable market. A factory may possess the equipment, workforce and capacity to assemble vehicles, yet its long-term sustainability depends on customers willing and able to purchase its products. This is where Sani’s call for government patronage becomes particularly significant. Government procurement can be an important instrument of industrial policy. Federal and state institutions require vehicles for official duties, field operations, inspections and administrative responsibilities. Where locally manufactured products meet the necessary requirements, directing a portion of that demand towards domestic producers can support industrial activity. Sani’s proposed engagement with the NEC seeks to extend this argument beyond Kaduna State. His objective is to encourage governments at both federal and state levels to consider D-PAN vehicles when making procurement decisions. His pledge that Kaduna State would place an order is equally important because it gives practical expression to the message he wants other governments to embrace. However, sustainable patronage must be built on more than declarations. Public procurement should consider price, quality, safety, durability, after-sales support, maintenance costs and value for money. Transparent purchasing processes and clear standards would help ensure that patronage supports local industry without compromising public accountability. For D-PAN and other Nigerian manufacturers, the opportunity is to demonstrate that locally produced vehicles can meet the operational requirements of institutional buyers while offering dependable service throughout their working life.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/p.body_zh: 乌巴·萨尼推动政府采购尼日利亚制造车辆，卡比尔·丹朱马撰写 当乌巴·萨尼州长在卡杜纳的丹戈特标致汽车尼日利亚（D-PAN）有限公司工厂揭幕2026款标致5008时，这一活动不仅仅代表一款新车型的推出。它提供了一个机会，来重新开启关于尼日利亚工业未来的重要对话：政府采购如何能够帮助维持本地制造、创造就业，并将国内生产转变为经济增长的驱动力。州长的信息很直接。尼日利亚政府应该做的不仅仅是庆祝本地制造的产品；它们应该为这些产品创造实际需求。通过承诺向国家经济委员会（NEC）提出强有力的建议，说明联邦和州政府部委、部门和机构（MDAs）需要采购D-PAN车辆，萨尼将公共采购置于工业发展辩论的中心。他还承诺卡杜纳州将订购其中一些车辆，并宣布他的政府打算以身作则。这一提议为尼日利亚制造业提出了一个根本性问题：当政府成为它希望发展的产业的积极客户时，会发生什么？标致5008的揭幕为州长提供了一个平台，来强调这家汽车组装厂对卡杜纳州的经济重要性。萨尼赞扬了阿尔哈吉·阿里科·丹戈特，称他通过在尼日利亚持续投资展现了爱国主义。他指出D-PAN创造了就业机会，帮助弥补技能差距，并在其周边环境和整个州内刺激了经济活动。这些贡献说明了为什么制造业的重要性超越了工厂车间。一家运营中的工业工厂会为工人、技术专长、物流、维护、供应和其他支持服务创造需求。其经济影响可以延伸到周边社区，那里的企业和家庭从工业活动产生的支出中受益。对于卡杜纳来说，加强这样一家企业提供了一个机会，来深化该州的工业基础，同时为居民创造参与生产性经济活动的途径。但工业投资也需要一个可靠的市场。一家工厂可能拥有设备、劳动力和组装车辆的能力，但其长期可持续性取决于愿意且有能力购买其产品的客户。这就是萨尼呼吁政府采购变得特别重要的地方。政府采购可以成为工业政策的重要工具。联邦和州机构需要车辆用于公务、实地行动、检查和行政职责。在本地制造产品满足必要要求的情况下，将部分需求导向国内生产商可以支持工业活动。萨尼提议与国家经济委员会的接触旨在将这一论点扩展到卡杜纳州之外。他的目标是鼓励联邦和州两级政府在做出采购决定时考虑D-PAN车辆。他承诺卡杜纳州将下订单同样重要，因为它为他希望其他政府接受的信息提供了实际表达。然而，可持续的采购必须建立在不仅仅是声明的基础上。公共采购应考虑价格、质量、安全、耐用性、售后支持、维护成本和性价比。透明的采购流程和明确的标准将有助于确保采购支持本地产业，同时不损害公共问责制。对于D-PAN和其他尼日利亚制造商来说，机会在于证明本地生产的车辆能够满足机构买家的运营要求，同时在其整个使用寿命中提供可靠的服务。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/a.summary_zh: 参议院议长戈兹维尔·阿克帕比奥反对将试图自杀非罪化的举动相当不幸。尽管参议院通过了由参议员阿苏库奥·埃克佩尼翁赞助的2026年预防自杀法案进行二读，但阿克帕比奥坚持认为幸存者应被监禁。该法案旨在将试图自杀非罪化，并为幸存者提供医疗治疗、康复和心理支持。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/a.body: The opposition of the Senate President, Godswill Akpabio, to the move to decriminalise attempted suicide is quite unfortunate. Although the Senate passed the Suicide Prevention Bill 2026, sponsored by Senator Asuquo Ekpenyong, for a second reading, Akpabio insisted that survivors should be jailed. The bill seeks to decriminalise attempted suicide and provide survivors with medical treatment, rehabilitation, and psychological support. “As far as we are concerned, we are saying that suicide is a crime for now,” Akpabio said at plenary. “Therefore, if you attempt it, you better succeed. If you don’t succeed, we will send you to prison.” Following Akpabio’s remark, the Association of Psychiatrists in Nigeria (APN) warned that threatening suicide attempt survivors with imprisonment could deepen stigma and discourage people experiencing mental health crises from seeking help. According to the APN, a person who survives a suicide attempt should be treated as someone experiencing severe psychological distress and requiring urgent medical attention, not punishment. “The appropriate response is urgent medical care, compassionate assessment, treatment, safety planning and follow-up—not a threat of imprisonment,” the APN said. The Ekpenyong bill proposes crisis helplines, public awareness programmes, training for police officers, teachers and health workers, and a national data system to strengthen suicide prevention. It also seeks to address what its sponsor described as inconsistencies between the National Mental Health Act, which recognises attempted suicide as a psychiatric emergency requiring intervention, and provisions of the Criminal Code and Penal Code that criminalise the act. After scaling a second reading last Tuesday, it was referred to the Senate Committees on Judiciary and Health for further legislative action, including a public hearing. Although Akpabio has said his position does not necessarily represent that of the Senate, it is still nonetheless unfortunate. Instructively, only two months ago in August, the Federal Executive Council (FEC) approved a proposal to amend the National Mental Health Act with the aim of removing criminal penalties for attempted suicide, officially shifting Nigeria’s legal framework from punishment to care and psychological support. Currently, both Section 327 of the Criminal Code Act (Southern Nigeria) and Section 231 of the Penal Code (Northern Nigeria) criminalise suicide attempts. Medical practitioners under the aegis of the Society of Family Physicians of Nigeria, (SOFPON) have for years been raising concerns about the growing number of Nigerians living with depression, a major risk factor for suicide. Besides, the nation’s present socio-economic environment has been a predisposing factor to depression and perhaps suicide. Therefore, to successfully deal with this problem of suicides, there is an urgent need to address the issue of stigma. On that score, we endorse the Ekpenyong bill and urge the National Assembly to expedite action on its passage. Mental illness is nothing to be ashamed of. Like diabetes and heart disease, it is a medical condition which is treatable. Many people with mental health illness return to a productive and fulfilling life after promptly seeking help. But the country is not doing enough to tackle this public health emergency, and it is responsible for the growing cases of suicides. Stemming the tide requires a multi-sectoral and multi-disciplinary approach involving various government ministries, agencies, and departments (MDAs), especially that of health, labour and employment, and social services. But it must begin with an amendment to the existing laws still in operation in Nigeria that criminalise a serious health challenge. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/a.title_zh: 阿克帕比奥与自杀法案
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/a.body_zh: 参议院议长戈兹维尔·阿克帕比奥反对将自杀未遂去罪化的举动非常不幸。虽然参议院已经通过了由参议员阿苏夸·埃克佩尼翁提出的2026年《自杀预防法案》进行二读，但阿克帕比奥坚持认为幸存者应该被监禁。该法案旨在将自杀未遂去罪化，并为幸存者提供医疗治疗、康复和心理支持。“就我们而言，我们现在认为自杀是一种犯罪，”阿克帕比奥在全体会议上说。“因此，如果你尝试自杀，你最好成功。如果你没有成功，我们将把你送进监狱。”在阿克帕比奥发表言论后，尼日利亚精神病学家协会（APN）警告说，用监禁威胁自杀未遂幸存者可能会加深污名化，并阻止正在经历心理健康危机的人们寻求帮助。根据APN的说法，自杀未遂的幸存者应该被视为正在经历严重心理困扰并需要紧急医疗护理的人，而不是受到惩罚。“适当的回应是紧急医疗护理、同情评估、治疗、安全规划和跟进——而不是监禁威胁，”APN表示。埃克佩尼翁法案提议设立危机热线、公共意识计划、对警察、教师和卫生工作者的培训，以及一个加强自杀预防的国家数据系统。它还寻求解决其提案人所描述的国家心理健康法案与刑法和刑罚法典规定之间的不一致，国家心理健康法案承认自杀未遂是一种需要干预的精神病紧急情况，而刑法和刑罚法典则将该行为定为犯罪。在上周二通过二读后，该法案被提交给参议院司法和卫生委员会，以采取进一步的立法行动，包括举行公众听证会。虽然阿克帕比奥表示他的立场不一定代表参议院的立场，但这仍然是不幸的。有启发意义的是，就在两个月前的8月，联邦执行委员会（FEC）批准了一项提案，旨在修订国家心理健康法案，以取消对自杀未遂的刑事处罚，正式将尼日利亚的法律框架从惩罚转向护理和心理支持。目前，《刑法典法》（尼日利亚南部）第327条和《刑罚法典》（尼日利亚北部）第231条都将自杀未遂定为犯罪。以尼日利亚家庭医生协会（SOFPON）名义的医学从业者多年来一直对越来越多的尼日利亚人患有抑郁症表示担忧，抑郁症是自杀的主要风险因素。此外，该国目前的社会经济环境一直是抑郁症乃至自杀的诱发因素。因此，要成功解决自杀问题，迫切需要解决污名化问题。在这一点上，我们支持埃克佩尼翁法案，并敦促国民议会加快通过该法案的行动。精神疾病没有什么可羞耻的。像糖尿病和心脏病一样，它是一种可以治疗的医疗状况。许多患有心理健康疾病的人在及时寻求帮助后，重新过上了富有成效和充实的生活。但该国在应对这一公共卫生紧急情况方面做得不够，这对越来越多的自杀案例负有责任。遏制这一趋势需要采取多部门和多学科的方法，涉及政府各部委、机构和部门（MDAs），特别是卫生、劳动和就业以及社会服务部门。但必须从修订尼日利亚现行仍将严重健康挑战定为犯罪的现有法律开始。THISDAY成立于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都特区和世界各地设有办事处。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/g.body: Grange School, Ikeja, emerged as the overall winner in the Under 13 and Under 15 categories at the second Pan African School Games, while St Saviour’s School, Ikoyi, claimed the overall title in the Under 11 category of the three-day tournament held at James Hopes College, Lekki. Grange School received a new bus sponsored by Mikano Changan Motors after securing the highest number of points in the Under 13 and Under 15 categories. St Saviour’s School dominated the Under 11 category, winning the overall title. The three-day event, held at James Hope College, Lekki, brought together more than 400 students from 11 schools. Organised by Seun Akinbohun, Busola Tejumola and Aderoju Ope Ajayi, the Games give children opportunities to compete, develop their sporting abilities and build friendships with students from other schools. This year’s edition attracted strong support from leading corporate organisations, including Prime Atlantic, Zenith Bank, Plumtre Advisory, Mikano Changan Motors, UAC Foods, Nigerian Exchange Group (NGX), Team 33 Productions, Flytime, What Media, Kantar, Logic City and Flutterwave. The Lagos State Government and the Lagos State Sports Commission also partnered with the organisers in support of the initiative. In the Under 11 category, St Saviour’s School, Ikoyi, won swimming and athletics, while St Saviour’s School and Lagos Preparatory & Secondary School shared the football title. St Saviour’s School secured the overall title in the age group. Grange School won swimming and athletics in both the Under 13 and Under 15 categories, while Riverbank School won football in both age groups. Grange School’s combined results placed it first in the overall standings for the Under 13 and Under 15 categories. Speaking at the event, the Director of Sports at the Lagos State Sports Commission, Travih Nunayon, commended the organisers and said the commission had deployed talent scouts to identify promising athletes during the Games. Nunayon, who represented the commission’s Director General, Lekan Fatodu, said the event provided an opportunity to discover young athletes and support their development. He added that discussions had begun with the organisers on sustaining the initiative. According to him, athletes identified during the competition could be considered for events such as the National Youth Games and the National Intermediate Games, with the commission continuing to monitor their progress. Co-founder Aderoju Ope Ajayi said the Games were established to help children develop their potential in sports alongside their education. She explained that the founders, who are also sports parents, understood the opportunities that participation in sport could offer, including scholarships. “We want children to look back and say this is where I was discovered, this is where I got a scholarship opportunity and this is where I had my opportunities,” she said. Ope Ajayi, who also serves as Chairman of the Lagos State Aquatics Association, welcomed the support from participating schools, families and partners. Participants and coaches commended the organisers and expressed hope that future editions would bring more schools together, giving more children the chance to compete, learn and enjoy school sports. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/g.body_zh: 格兰奇学校（Grange School）伊凯贾校区在第二届泛非学校运动会的13岁以下和15岁以下组别中脱颖而出，成为总冠军，而圣救世主学校（St Saviour’s School）伊科伊校区则在为期三天的赛事中获得11岁以下组别总冠军，该赛事在莱基的詹姆斯霍普学院（James Hopes College）举行。格兰奇学校在13岁以下和15岁以下组别中获得最高积分后，收到了一辆由Mikano Changan Motors赞助的新巴士。圣救世主学校在11岁以下组别中占据主导地位，赢得总冠军。为期三天的赛事在詹姆斯霍普学院（James Hope College）莱基校区举行，汇集了来自11所学校的400多名学生。由Seun Akinbohun、Busola Tejumola和Aderoju Ope Ajayi组织的这项运动会为孩子们提供了竞争、发展体育能力和与其他学校学生建立友谊的机会。今年的赛事获得了领先企业组织的强力支持，包括Prime Atlantic、Zenith Bank、Plumtre Advisory、Mikano Changan Motors、UAC Foods、Nigerian Exchange Group (NGX)、Team 33 Productions、Flytime、What Media、Kantar、Logic City和Flutterwave。拉各斯州政府和拉各斯州体育委员会也与组织者合作支持该倡议。在11岁以下组别中，圣救世主学校伊科伊校区赢得了游泳和田径项目，而圣救世主学校和拉各斯预备及中学（Lagos Preparatory & Secondary School）分享了足球冠军。圣救世主学校获得了该年龄组的总冠军。格兰奇学校在13岁以下和15岁以下两个组别中均赢得了游泳和田径项目，而Riverbank School在两个年龄组中均赢得了足球冠军。格兰奇学校的综合成绩使其在13岁以下和15岁以下组别的总排名中位居第一。在活动上发表讲话的拉各斯州体育委员会体育主任Travih Nunayon对组织者表示赞扬，并表示委员会已派出人才侦察员在运动会期间发现有前途的运动员。代表委员会总干事Lekan Fatodu的Nunayon表示，此项赛事提供了发现年轻运动员并支持他们发展的机会。他补充说，已开始与组织者讨论如何持续推进该倡议。据他介绍，在比赛期间发现的运动员可被考虑参加国家青年运动会和国家中级运动会等赛事，委员会将继续跟踪他们的进展。联合创始人Aderoju Ope Ajayi表示，创办这项运动会是为了帮助孩子们在接受教育的同时发展他们在体育方面的潜力。她解释说，创始人本身也是体育家长，他们理解参与体育所能提供的机会，包括奖学金。“我们希望孩子们回首时可以说，这就是我被发现的地方，这就是我获得奖学金机会的地方，这就是我获得机会的地方，”她说。同样担任拉各斯州水上运动协会主席的Ope Ajayi对参与学校、家庭和合作伙伴的支持表示欢迎。参与者和教练对组织者表示赞扬，并希望未来的赛事能汇聚更多学校，让更多孩子有机会竞争、学习和享受学校体育。THISDAY创刊于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都特区及世界各地设有办事处。它是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，在所有平台上为政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级提供服务，同时作为新思想、文化和技术交汇点，服务于有抱负者和千禧一代。该报是一种公共信托，致力于追求真理和理性，涵盖从突发新闻到政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区以及人与社会交汇点的一系列议题。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/survivors-fe.body: Survivors of sexual abuse often grapple with guilt and emotional distress, sometimes blaming themselves for failing to prevent the abuse, a survivor advocate, Amtu Akumfi-Ameyaw, has said. She said those feelings could become more painful when trusted adults, including teachers and housemistresses expected to offer protection, failed to provide the support survivors needed. Speaking on Joy News’ PM Express on Monday, October 19, Ms Akumfi-Ameyaw, co-founder of On This Side, a survivor-focused initiative, said the allegations of sexual abuse involving female students of Obuasi Senior High Technical School (SHTS) had brought back memories of why it took her so long to speak about her own experience. The allegations are the subject of investogative journalist Manasseh Azure Awuni’s documentary, Inside the Dreaded Headmaster’s Bungalow . It examines alleged sexual abuse involving female students at Obuasi Senior High Technical School. “I don't know if I should cry. I don't know if I should scream. I'm having, like, mixed feelings,” she said, describing her reaction to the developments. She explained that survivors could feel disappointed in themselves after someone violated their personal boundaries, believing they should have been able to protect themselves. “So there's a certain level of supposed guilt that you have that you couldn't protect yourself from abuse," she said. Ms Akumfi-Ameyaw said the situation could become even more distressing when people survivors trusted to help them were unable to offer the necessary support. The advocate identified teachers, housemistresses and other school authorities as people students might naturally turn to when they experienced abuse. However, she said the failure of such trusted figures to respond appropriately could reinforce survivors’ feelings of guilt and leave them questioning whether their experiences mattered. She said hearing people laugh about or trivialise alleged abuse could deepen that emotional burden. The response survivors received after disclosing their experiences was therefore critical, she suggested, because it could affect their willingness to continue speaking out. Ms Akumfi-Ameyaw said some survivors who initially disclosed their experiences might later withdraw their accounts because of the personal struggles they faced. “And it's the reason why you would actually even have some people come out to say their stories and eventually change their mind and say that you know what, everything was a lie. It never happened,” she said. She added that survivors were often dealing with difficult emotions that others might not fully appreciate
https://www.myjoyonline.com/survivors-fe.title_zh: 幸存者对未能保护自己免受性虐待感到内疚——倡导者
https://www.myjoyonline.com/survivors-fe.body_zh: 性虐待幸存者常常与内疚和情绪困扰作斗争，有时会自责未能阻止虐待，一位幸存者倡导者Amtu Akumfi-Ameyaw说。她说，当包括教师和女舍监在内的受信任成年人本应提供保护却未能给予幸存者所需的支持时，这些感受可能会变得更加痛苦。在10月19日星期一的Joy News《PM Express》节目上发言时，On This Side（一个以幸存者为中心的倡议）的联合创始人Akumfi-Ameyaw女士说，涉及奥布阿西高级技术学校（SHTS）女学生的性虐待指控，让她回忆起为什么她花了这么长时间才说出自己的经历。这些指控是调查记者Manasseh Azure Awuni的纪录片《Inside the Dreaded Headmaster’s Bungalow》的主题。它调查了涉及奥布阿西高级技术学校女学生的所谓性虐待。“我不知道我是否应该哭。我不知道我是否应该尖叫。我有一种复杂的感觉，”她在描述自己对事态发展的反应时说。她解释说，在有人侵犯了他们的个人界限后，幸存者可能会对自己感到失望，认为他们本应该能够保护自己。“所以你会有某种程度的自责，认为你无法保护自己免受虐待，”她说。Akumfi-Ameyaw女士说，当幸存者信任来帮助他们的人无法提供必要支持时，情况可能会变得更加令人痛苦。这位倡导者指出，教师、女舍监和其他学校管理人员是学生在遭受虐待时自然会求助的人。然而，她说，这些受信任人物未能做出适当回应可能会强化幸存者的内疚感，并让他们质疑自己的经历是否重要。她说，听到人们嘲笑或轻视所谓虐待可能会加深这种情绪负担。因此，她建议，幸存者在披露经历后得到的回应至关重要，因为它可能会影响他们继续发声的意愿。Akumfi-Ameyaw女士说，一些最初披露自己经历的幸存者后来可能会撤回他们的说法，因为他们面临个人挣扎。“这就是为什么你甚至会看到一些人站出来讲述他们的故事，最终改变主意说，你知道吗，一切都是谎言。它从未发生过，”她说。她补充说，幸存者常常在处理他人可能无法完全理解的困难情绪

https://dailytrust.com/inec-and-neutrali.body: F resh controversies have resurfaced over the redeployment of key personnel of the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) ahead of the 2027 general elections. In the recent changes at INEC, Mrs Oluyemi Titilayo Adeyemi-Showunmi, formerly the Administrative Secretary of the commission’s Lagos State office, was redeployed as the Director of Electoral Operations at the commission. She is the wife of Segun Showunmi, a spokesman for the Tinubu/Shettima 2027 Presidential Campaign Council. Prof. Mustapha Aliu, identified as an elder brother of Sokoto State Governor, Ahmed Aliyu, who is seeking a second term on the platform of the All Progressives Congress (APC), has also been nominated as an INEC commissioner. According to reports, Isah Magaji Gummi, who previously headed the Electoral Operations Department, was redeployed to the Voter Registry Department. The Electoral Operations Department plays a key role in election planning and implementation, including the coordination of polling arrangements, deployment of election materials and management of personnel involved in electoral operations. Although the director of the department does not independently determine election results, the responsibilities attached to the office have drawn attention to the redeployment and calls for INEC to explain the considerations behind the decision. Adeyemi-Showunmi’s redeployment has sparked debate among civil society organisations and on social media over transparency, political neutrality and public confidence in the electoral body. Former director of voter education at INEC, Mr Nick Dazang, when contacted said, it would be wrong for the Commission to pretend that appointing someone that close to a sitting governor who is contesting elections has no implications. “The person may be eminently qualified but I have profound misgivings if he can discharge or execute his office as Resident Electoral Commissioner with the professionalism, neutrality and impartiality that the office demands. He said In such circumstances, and in deference to its core values, INEC has demonstrated sensitivity by not posting such deserving officials to these positions. “It is likely that the Commission may not be aware or cognizant of the said officer’s relationship with a prominent politician. “But once this is established, and its attention is called to this reality, it should promptly do the needful, namely: not to put the officer in a position that compromises the Commission’s principles of neutrality and provision of a level playing field to all contestants. In the prevailing circumstance, the officer should be directed to recuse herself. This will allay fears, rightly or wrongly, that she has been procured to deliberately confer an advantage to any candidate(s) in the election. Either the tenure of the subsisting Director is specially extended for the period of the election, or his Deputy is directed to act in the position of Director, subject to consideration(s) of merit, federal character and the core values aforementioned,” he added. Director-General of YIAGA Africa, Samson Itodo, warned that the electoral body must ensure public confidence in the electoral process and should not take the people for granted in its appointment. On the appointment of Adeyemi-Showunmi as INEC Director of Electoral Operations, Itodo said elections are fundamentally about operations, adding that by this token, it is one of the most sensitive and consequential departments within INEC. He said, “In fact, the Electoral Operations Department is at the heart of election administration. From the recruitment and deployment of polling officials to the planning, production and distribution of election materials, as well as the operational arrangements for voting and results collation, the department plays a central role in determining how elections are conducted. “Mrs. Showunmi’s competence and professional capacity are not in doubt.
https://dailytrust.com/inec-and-neutrali.body_zh: 围绕独立国家选举委员会（INEC）在2027年大选前重新部署关键人员的问题，新的争议重新浮出水面。在INEC最近的人事变动中，原该委员会拉各斯州办公室行政秘书奥卢耶米·蒂蒂拉约·阿德耶米-肖温米夫人被重新部署为委员会选举行动主任。她是蒂努布/谢蒂马2027年总统竞选委员会发言人塞贡·肖温米的妻子。被确认为索科托州州长艾哈迈德·阿利尤兄长的穆斯塔法·阿利尤教授也已被提名为INEC专员，阿利尤州长正寻求以全进步大会党（APC）平台竞选连任。据报道，此前负责选举行动部的伊萨·马加吉·古米被重新部署到选民登记部。选举行动部在选举规划和实施中发挥关键作用，包括协调投票安排、部署选举材料以及管理参与选举行动的人员。虽然该部门主任不能独立决定选举结果，但与该职位相关的职责已引起对此次重新部署的关注，并呼吁INEC解释这一决定背后的考量。阿德耶米-肖温米的重新部署已在民间社会组织和社交媒体上引发辩论，焦点是透明度、政治中立性以及公众对选举机构的信心。INEC前选民教育主任尼克·达赞先生在被联系时表示，委员会如果假装任命与正在竞选的现任州长关系如此密切的人没有影响，那是错误的。“这个人可能非常合格，但我深感担忧的是，他能否以该职位所要求的专业性、中立性和公正性履行或执行其作为驻地选举专员的职责。他说，在这种情况下，出于对其核心价值的尊重，INEC已通过不将此类应得官员派到这些职位来表现出敏感性。“很可能委员会可能不知道或未意识到该官员与一位知名政治人物的关系。“但一旦这一情况被确定，并且其注意力被引向这一现实，它就应迅速采取必要行动，即：不将该官员置于可能损害委员会中立性原则和为所有竞选者提供公平竞争环境的职位。在当前情况下，该官员应被指示回避。这将缓解无论对错的担忧，即她被利用来故意为选举中的任何候选人赋予优势。要么现任主任的任期为选举期间特别延长，要么指示其副手代理主任职位，但需考虑功绩、联邦特征和上述核心价值，”他补充道。YIAGA Africa总干事萨姆森·伊托多警告说，选举机构必须确保公众对选举进程的信心，在任命中不应把人民视为理所当然。在阿德耶米-肖温米被任命为INEC选举行动主任的问题上，伊托多说，选举从根本上来说是关于行动的，并补充说，因此，这是INEC内部最敏感和最重要的部门之一。他说，“事实上，选举行动部处于选举管理的核心。从招募和部署投票官员，到选举材料的规划、生产和分发，以及投票和结果汇总的操作安排，该部门在决定选举如何进行方面发挥核心作用。“肖温米夫人的能力和专业水平毋庸置疑。

https://dailytrust.com/where-is-nlng-div.summary_zh: 据他介绍，此次行动旨在确定NLNG股息支付的范围，并确定是否已完全说明应付给各州和地方政府的金额。他说：“尼日利亚州长论坛（NGF）在联邦政府的支持下，聘请了一名顾问来核对NLNG股息支付。目前的争端也重新引发了关于NLNG股息支付历史处理方式的问题。
https://dailytrust.com/where-is-nlng-div.body: The controversy bothers on two positions: the Presidency’s assertion that the Federation has received $21.5 billion in NLNG dividends over 25 years, and Makinde’s claim that a reconciliation exercise commissioned by the Nigeria Governors’ Forum (NGF) identified an accumulated shortfall of about N9 trillion due to states and local governments. While the Presidency has maintained that the figures being circulated should be disregarded, the governor insists that the amount represents money owed to the subnational governments over time, rather than a single dividend payment that should be made to each state. The disagreement has triggered fresh questions about the volume of dividends paid by NLNG, the share accruing to the Federation, the formula used to distribute the revenue and whether historical payments were properly captured in the relevant accounts. Stakeholders in the energy sector have also raised concerns about documentation, transparency and the need to establish whether the alleged shortfall reflects an accounting discrepancy, an outstanding obligation or a disagreement over the interpretation of the revenue-sharing framework. In a statement on Sunday, the presidential spokesman, Bayo Onanuga, disclosed that NLNG had paid $21.5 billion in dividends into the Federation Account over 25 years. According to him, less than $3 billion of the amount has been received since President Bola Tinubu assumed office. According to the Presidency, if each state of the Federation receives N250bn as a “one-off distribution,” that would amount to N9 trillion, excluding the Federal Government, the Federal Capital Territory and the 774 local councils nationwide. Using the sharing formula of the Federation Account Allocation Committee as a standard, states receive 26.72% of the distributable Federation Account revenue. The Presidency therefore reiterated that the NLNG has never paid $25bn in dividends to the Federation Account in a single payout. The dispute comes as NLNG continues to expand its operations and consolidate its position in the global liquefied natural gas market. At the unveiling of its Facts and Figures 2026 publication, NLNG said it had generated $149.6 billion in revenue since commencing operations, paid $47.2 billion in dividends to shareholders and remitted $10.8 billion in taxes to the Federal Government since becoming tax-compliant in 2009. Daily Trust reports that NLNG has four shareholders. The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC Ltd) holds 49 per cent, while Shell holds 25.6 per cent, TotalEnergies has 15 per cent and Eni owns 10.4 per cent. The Federation’s 49 per cent interest is held through NNPC Ltd. Consequently, the $21.5 billion cited by the Presidency represents the amount attributed to the Federation’s interest, rather than the company’s total dividend payments to all shareholders. The other shareholders collectively account for the remaining 51 per cent. Makinde had disputed the Presidency’s interpretation of the figures, maintaining that the N9 trillion claim relates to accumulated underpayments identified during a reconciliation exercise involving the Federal Government and the NGF. In his account, the exercise was undertaken to establish the extent of NLNG dividend payments and determine whether the amounts due to states and local governments had been fully accounted for. The governor said the reconciliation identified a shortfall of about N9 trillion. He said: “The Nigeria Governors’ Forum (NGF), with the Federal Government’s support, engaged a consultant to reconcile NLNG dividend payments. The exercise identified a shortfall of about N9 trillion due to states and local governments. The Federal Government accepted the findings. The report remains in the custody of both the Federal Government and the NGF.” On Monday, Makinde insisted that the Federal Government was withholding N250 billion in Nigeria LNG Limited (NLNG) dividends for each state in the country.
https://dailytrust.com/where-is-nlng-div.body_zh: 争议围绕两个立场展开：总统府声称联邦在25年间从NLNG获得215亿美元的分红，以及马金德的主张，即由尼日利亚州长论坛（NGF）委托进行的对账工作发现，州和地方政府累计短缺约9万亿奈拉。虽然总统府坚持认为正在流传的数字应被忽略，但州长坚持认为，该金额代表长期以来欠付给次国家政府的款项，而不是应一次性支付给每个州的单一分红款项。这一分歧引发了对NLNG支付的分红总额、归属于联邦的份额、用于分配收入的公式以及历史付款是否被正确记录在相关账户中的新问题。能源部门的利益相关者还对文件记录、透明度以及是否需要确定所谓短缺是否反映会计差异、未履行义务或对收入分享框架解释的分歧提出了担忧。周日，总统发言人巴约·奥纳努加在一份声明中透露，NLNG在25年间已向联邦账户支付了215亿美元的分红。据他介绍，自博拉·蒂努布总统就职以来，已收到该金额中不到30亿美元的部分。根据总统府的说法，如果联邦的每个州获得2500亿奈拉作为“一次性分配”，那将总计达到9万亿奈拉，不包括联邦政府、联邦首都区和全国774个地方政府理事会。使用联邦账户分配委员会的分享公式作为标准，州获得可分配联邦账户收入的26.72%。因此总统府重申，NLNG从未一次性向联邦账户支付250亿美元的分红。这一争端发生之际，NLNG正在继续扩大其业务并巩固其在全球液化天然气市场的地位。在其《2026年事实与数据》出版物发布会上，NLNG表示自开始运营以来已产生1496亿美元的收入，向股东支付了472亿美元的分红，并在2009年开始履行纳税义务以来向联邦政府汇缴了108亿美元的税款。Daily Trust报道称NLNG有四个股东。尼日利亚国家石油公司有限公司（NNPC Ltd）持有49%，壳牌持有25.6%，道达尔能源持有15%，埃尼持有10.4%。联邦的49%权益通过NNPC Ltd持有。因此，总统府引用的215亿美元代表归属于联邦权益的金额，而不是公司向所有股东支付的总分红款项。其他股东共同占剩余的51%。马金德对总统府对这些数字的解释提出异议，坚持认为9万亿奈拉的主张与联邦政府和NGF参与的对账工作中发现的累计少付有关。据他介绍，进行这项工作是为了确定NLNG分红支付的程度，并确定是否已完全核算应付给州和地方政府的金额。州长表示，对账工作发现了约9万亿奈拉的短缺。他说：“尼日利亚州长论坛（NGF）在联邦政府的支持下，聘请了一名顾问来对NLNG分红支付进行对账。该工作发现了约9万亿奈拉应付给州和地方政府的短缺。联邦政府接受了调查结果。该报告仍由联邦政府和NGF保管。”周一，马金德坚持认为联邦政府正在扣留全国每个州的2500亿奈拉尼日利亚液化天然气有限公司（NLNG）分红。

https://dailytrust.com/uduaghan-life-pol.body: Former Delta State Governor Emmanuel Uduaghan has died at the age of 71, three days before his 72nd birthday. Uduaghan died on Monday morning, October 19, 2026, according to a statement issued on behalf of the family by Toju Anire Uduaghan. The family described his death as a profound loss, saying he was a source of strength and a father figure whose life touched many people in Delta State and beyond. “His passing has left us devastated. Words can hardly express the depth of our sorrow at the loss of a man who meant so much to our family and whose life and service touched countless others across Delta State and Nigeria,” the statement said. Born on October 22, 1954, Uduaghan was a medical doctor of Itsekiri origin from Warri North Local Government Area of Delta State. He governed the state from 2007 to 2015, a period marked by political controversies, infrastructure projects, sporting achievements and a fierce struggle over his successor. Before becoming governor, he served as Commissioner for Health from May 1999 to May 2003 under former Governor James Ibori. He was later appointed Secretary to the State Government in June 2003, a position he held until the end of Ibori’s administration in 2007. Uduaghan attended Federal Government College, Warri, from 1968 to 1974 and studied medicine at the University of Benin from 1975 to 1980, earning an MBBS degree. He also obtained a diploma in Anaesthesia. Uduaghan’s eight years in office were marked by political battles, including controversies over his predecessor’s corruption allegations and a struggle to determine who would succeed him. His first tenure was briefly interrupted when the Court of Appeal nullified his election shortly before the 2011 general elections. The Speaker of the Delta State House of Assembly, Sam Obi, served as acting governor for about three months before Uduaghan won the rerun election and returned to office. His administration also faced criticism over its handling of allegations against Ibori, who was eventually convicted of corruption-related offences in the United Kingdom and sentenced to prison. Critics accused Uduaghan of failing to investigate and prosecute his predecessor despite allegations and petitions against him. The controversy remained a significant part of the political narrative surrounding his administration. Although some associates described Uduaghan as generous during his years as commissioner and secretary to the state government, others reportedly felt his approach to spending changed after he became governor. Unlike Ibori, whose administration embarked on several ambitious projects, Uduaghan was not widely associated with a similarly expansive construction programme. One explanation offered at the time was that his government faced financial obligations inherited from his predecessor. However, his administration recorded notable infrastructure and sporting achievements. Among its prominent projects were flyovers at Effurun in Warri and along Summit Road in Asaba. The Summit Road flyover was later named after him. His government also sustained Delta State’s strong position in Nigerian sports. The state won the National Sports Festival in successive editions during his administration. Uduaghan’s tenure was also associated with the rise of Delta-born football administrator Amaju Pinnick, who became president of the Nigeria Football Federation. One of the biggest setbacks of Uduaghan’s political career was his failure to install his preferred successor in 2015. He initially backed Tony Obuh, a permanent secretary from Ika, to succeed him. He later dropped that position and supported David Edevbie, an Urhobo politician widely regarded as Ibori’s preferred candidate. The succession battle exposed divisions within the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), which was then the ruling party in the state. Amid the contest, Ifeanyi Okowa emerged as the party’s governorship candidate and won the general election, succeeding Uduaghan in May 2015.
https://dailytrust.com/uduaghan-life-pol.title_zh: 乌杜阿汉：人生、政治斗争、争议
https://dailytrust.com/uduaghan-life-pol.body_zh: 前三角州州长埃马努埃尔·乌杜阿汉已于71岁去世，距离他72岁生日仅剩三天。根据托朱·阿尼雷·乌杜阿汉代表家属发表的声明，乌杜阿汉于2026年10月19日星期一上午去世。家属形容他的去世是巨大的损失，称他是一位力量的源泉和父亲般的人物，其一生影响了三角州及以外的许多人。“他的离世让我们悲痛欲绝。语言难以表达我们对失去一位对我们家庭意义重大、其生命和服务惠及三角州和尼日利亚无数人的男人的悲伤之深。”声明说。乌杜阿汉出生于1954年10月22日，是一名伊策基里族裔的医生，来自三角州瓦里北地方政府区。他从2007年至2015年担任该州州长，这一时期充满了政治争议、基础设施项目、体育成就以及围绕其继任者的激烈斗争。在成为州长之前，他于1999年5月至2003年5月在前州长詹姆斯·伊博里领导下担任卫生专员。随后他于2003年6月被任命为州政府秘书，这一职位他一直担任到伊博里政府2007年结束。乌杜阿汉于1968年至1974年在瓦里联邦政府学院就读，并于1975年至1980年在贝宁大学攻读医学，获得MBBS学位。他还获得了麻醉学文凭。乌杜阿汉执政八年期间充满了政治斗争，包括围绕其前任腐败指控的争议以及决定谁将继任他的斗争。他的第一个任期曾短暂中断，当时上诉法院在其2011年大选前不久宣布其选举无效。三角州议会发言人萨姆·奥比担任代理州长约三个月，随后乌杜阿汉赢得重选并重返职位。他的政府还因处理针对伊博里的指控而受到批评，伊博里最终在英国被判犯有与腐败相关的罪行并被判处监禁。批评者指责乌杜阿汉未能调查和起诉其前任，尽管有针对他的指控和请愿。这一争议仍然是他政府政治叙事的重要组成部分。虽然一些亲信形容乌杜阿汉在担任专员和州政府秘书期间慷慨大方，但据称其他人认为他成为州长后在开支方面的做法发生了变化。与伊博里政府启动多项雄心勃勃的项目不同，乌杜阿汉并未广泛与类似大规模建设计划联系在一起。当时提供的一种解释是，他的政府面临从前任继承的财政义务。然而，他的政府在基础设施和体育方面取得了显著成就。其突出项目包括瓦里埃富伦的立交桥和阿萨巴峰会路沿线的立交桥。峰会路立交桥后来以他的名字命名。他的政府还维持了三角州在尼日利亚体育领域的强势地位。该州在他的政府期间连续几届赢得全国体育节。乌杜阿汉的任期还与三角州出生的足球管理人员阿马朱·皮尼克的崛起有关，后者成为尼日利亚足球联合会主席。乌杜阿汉政治生涯最大的挫折之一是他在2015年未能安排其首选继任者。他最初支持来自伊卡的常务秘书托尼·奥布赫接替他。后来他放弃了这一立场，转而支持被广泛视为伊博里首选候选人的乌尔霍博政治家戴维·埃德夫比。这场继任斗争暴露了当时作为州执政党的人民民主党（PDP）内部的分歧。在竞争中，伊费安伊·奥科瓦成为该党州长候选人并赢得大选，于2015年5月接替乌杜阿汉。
