https://dailytrust.com/flood-claims-2-li.body: T wo people have lost their lives while 18 communities have been submerged following massive flooding that ravaged parts of Nasarawa State. Some of the affected villages are Kwatan Bala, Olegokeme, Obendo, Achepe, Olegokpa, Ijiwo, Olegabgulu, Otiya-Gekye, Otiya-Giso, Odagede, Anagoga and Otariga, all under Rukubi and Akpanaja Wards of Doma Local Government Area of the state. The flood, which residents described as massive, displaced thousands of people, destroyed several buildings, farmlands and property worth millions of naira. Residents of the affected communities who narrated their ordeals said the disaster started about two weeks ago, when water volume from the River Benue increased and gradually entered farms and homes. A resident of Obendo village, Mr Joel Daniel Onuminya, said Obendo is among the communities badly hit by the flood, adding that so much was lost by residents as crops that were about to be harvested were submerged, leaving many families unable to feed. He said the flood also affected some buildings, forcing some people to renovate their houses, while others had to relocate temporarily. Onuminya noted that though the water has started subsiding and some people have started returning to their homes, the damage was enormous. When asked if such flooding is experienced every year, he said it is not a yearly occurrence, but depends on the opening of the Lagdo Dam in Cameroon and heavy rainfall. He recalled that the community experienced a similar level of destruction in 2012, adding that the current flood, though not as massive as that of 2012, has caused serious damage, including landslides that swept houses into the water. Appealing to the government, Onuminya said the affected communities need urgent assistance as many people can no longer feed their families, having lost their crops which they rely on for livelihood and for paying their children’s school fees. Also, a resident of Otiya village, Mr Ogiri Philip Usman, said the flood destroyed a lot of property in his community, though the water is now receding. He said the disaster affected mainly houses and farming products, forcing some residents, especially women, to leave the village for safer places. According to him, as the water is getting back to normal, some of the displaced residents have started returning to their houses. Usman clarified that schools, hospitals and other public facilities were also destroyed, saying houses and farmlands were badly affected. He appealed to the government to come to the aid of residents of Otiya, adding that whatever the government does will be appreciated. He said the community will be grateful for any assistance to help them recover from the losses incurred as a result of the flood. Similarly, a resident of Ijiwo, Mr Sunday Ijiwo, said the flood had submerged communities for about two weeks, destroying houses and displacing residents. According to him, displaced residents had sought refuge on higher ground and in other safer locations within the area. Ijiwo said the communities experienced flooding almost every year around this period, but described this year’s incident as worse than previous ones. He appealed to the government to provide a permanent relocation site for residents, as well as relief materials, including food, clothing and building supplies. Meanwhile, the Director-General of the Nasarawa State Emergency Management Agency (NASEMA), Benjamin Akwash, said more than 4,000 people had been displaced and that the agency was procuring relief materials for distribution to the victims. The DG disclosed this during an interview after leading a delegation on an assessment visit to the affected communities. He said the assessment followed a complaint by the member representing Doma South Constituency in the Nasarawa State House of Assembly, Hon.
https://dailytrust.com/flood-claims-2-li.title_zh: 洪水夺走2人生命，淹没纳萨拉瓦州18个社区
https://dailytrust.com/flood-claims-2-li.body_zh: 两人丧生，18个社区被淹没，此前大规模洪水肆虐了纳萨拉瓦州部分地区。受影响的部分村庄包括Kwatan Bala、Olegokeme、Obendo、Achepe、Olegokpa、Ijiwo、Olegabgulu、Otiya-Gekye、Otiya-Giso、Odagede、Anagoga和Otariga，全部位于该州Doma地方政府区的Rukubi和Akpanaja Ward之下。居民形容这场洪水规模巨大，导致数千人流离失所，摧毁了多栋建筑、农田和价值数百万奈拉的财产。受影响社区的居民在讲述他们的遭遇时表示，这场灾难大约两周前开始，当时贝努埃河的水量增加，逐渐进入农田和房屋。Obendo村的一位居民Joel Daniel Onuminya先生说，Obendo是受洪水严重影响的社区之一，并补充说居民损失惨重，因为即将收获的农作物被淹没，导致许多家庭无法糊口。他说洪水还影响了一些建筑，迫使一些人翻修房屋，而其他人则不得不暂时搬迁。Onuminya指出，虽然水位已经开始消退，一些人也已开始返回家园，但损失巨大。当被问及是否每年都发生这样的洪水时，他说这不是每年都发生，而是取决于喀麦隆Lagdo大坝的开闸和强降雨。他回忆说，该社区在2012年经历了类似程度的破坏，并补充说目前的洪水虽然不如2012年那次规模大，但已造成严重破坏，包括山体滑坡将房屋卷入水中。Onuminya呼吁政府提供帮助，他说受影响的社区需要紧急援助，因为许多人失去了赖以谋生和支付孩子学费的农作物，再也无法养家糊口。此外，Otiya村的一位居民Ogiri Philip Usman先生说，洪水摧毁了他所在社区的大量财产，尽管现在水位正在消退。他说这场灾难主要影响了房屋和农产品，迫使一些居民尤其是妇女离开村庄前往更安全的地方。据他说，随着水位恢复正常，一些流离失所的居民已开始返回家园。Usman澄清说，学校、医院和其他公共设施也被摧毁，并表示房屋和农田受到严重影响。他呼吁政府前来援助Otiya的居民，并补充说政府所做的任何事情都会受到感谢。他说，该社区将感激任何帮助他们从洪水造成的损失中恢复过来的援助。同样，Ijiwo的一位居民Sunday Ijiwo先生说，洪水已经淹没了社区大约两周，摧毁了房屋并导致居民流离失所。据他说，流离失所的居民已在该地区较高地势和其他更安全的地方寻求庇护。Ijiwo说，这些社区几乎每年这个时候都会经历洪水，但将今年的事件描述为比以往更严重。他呼吁政府为居民提供永久搬迁地点，以及包括食物、衣物和建筑用品在内的救济物资。与此同时，纳萨拉瓦州紧急事务管理局（NASEMA）局长Benjamin Akwash表示，已有超过4000人流离失所，该机构正在采购救济物资分发给灾民。局长是在带领代表团对受影响社区进行评估访问后接受采访时披露这一信息的。他说，此次评估是在纳萨拉瓦州议会Doma South选区议员Hon.提出的投诉之后进行的。

https://dailytrust.com/our-next-move-lie.summary: Leader of the eight Zamfara lawmakers that resigned from the All Progressives Congress (APC) due to alleged injustice, Aliyu Ango Kagara, said he and his colleagues have not taken a final decision on returning to the APC even after meeting with President Bola Ahmed Tinubu. https://dailytrust.com/our-next-move-lie.summary_zh: 因所谓不公而从进步大会党（APC）辞职的八名赞法拉州议员的领导人阿里尤·安戈·卡加拉表示，即使在与总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布会面后，他和他的同事们也尚未就重返APC做出最终决定。卡加拉重申，议员们尚未改变离开APC的决定，坚持认为他们没有告诉总统他们已重返该党。
https://dailytrust.com/our-next-move-lie.body: Leader of the eight Zamfara lawmakers that resigned from the All Progressives Congress (APC) due to alleged injustice, Aliyu Ango Kagara, said he and his colleagues have not taken a final decision on returning to the APC even after meeting with President Bola Ahmed Tinubu. Daily Trust reported that the eight resigned from the APC in protest but were taken to see the President by the minister of state for defence, Bello Matawalle on Sunday to pave the way for their return to the APC. Kagara who gave an insight into what transpired at the meeting with the President, said they’re yet to reunite with the APC but had attended a meeting with the president following an invitation to explain their position and the origins of the crisis. “We were at the Presidential Villa on invitation. Initially, some of us attempted to reject it, but we later agreed to honour the invitation out of respect for the President,” Kagara said. He added that Tinubu explained that he had invited them to hear their side of the story because he had received different accounts of what transpired. “The president said he invited us to hear what really transpired because he had heard different versions of the story,” he said. Kagara reiterated that the lawmakers had not reversed their decision to leave the APC, insisting that they did not tell the president they had returned to the party. “Even the president knew that we had left the party, and we did not tell him that we had returned,” he said adding that they briefed President Tinubu on what they described as the injustices they had suffered, adding that the President promised to invite the other faction to a meeting with them to find a solution to the crisis. On the possibility of returning to the APC, Kagara said the decision was beyond the individual lawmakers, stressing that their constituents had a say in the matter. “Our people have the final say. We are struggling for their voices to be heard,” he said. He also maintained that their position remained unchanged: the insecurity affecting their constituencies must be addressed decisively. “The issue of settling our entitlement to return to the APC does not even arise. Initially, we confronted Governor Lawal to sit up and address insecurity, and we are still on that. “Had it been that we agreed to remain silent on insecurity, we would have been treated equally. But we resisted, and we told Mr President that more needed to be done on the issue of insecurity. He assured us that he would do more. We need our people to survive; payment of our entitlement is just a secondary issue,” he said. Kagara also accused Governor Dauda Lawal of failing to do what was expected of him to complement the Federal Government’s efforts to tackle insecurity in the state. He dismissed claims by some members of the state House of Assembly that the government had achieved 89 per cent success in addressing insecurity, describing the figure as false. “Those members in the State Assembly are just propaganda that the government had achieved 89 per cent on security, which is a blatant lie,” he said. Kagara further alleged that the state government is not doing enough to address the worsening security situation. He revealed that President Tinubu had indicated his intention to invite Governor Lawal and the lawmakers to a meeting, adding that this was why they had refrained from making further public comments on the matter. “Governor Lawal is not doing anything on insecurity, looking at the growing rate of the menace. But the president said he would invite the governor and us. That is why we did not intend to say anything because we do not know what to say about it,” Kagara said. The State Auditor of the APC and Publicity Secretary of the Matawalle Political Standing Committee, Malam Yusuf Idris Gusau, said the minister took steps to bring the lawmakers before President Bola Tinubu as part of efforts to strengthen the party ahead of the elections.
https://dailytrust.com/our-next-move-lie.title_zh: 我们的下一步取决于人民——赞法拉州议员
https://dailytrust.com/our-next-move-lie.body_zh: 因所谓不公而从全体进步大会党（APC）辞职的八名赞法拉州议员的领导人阿里尤·安戈·卡加拉表示，即使在与总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布会面后，他和同事们仍未就重返APC做出最终决定。据Daily Trust报道，这八人因抗议而从APC辞职，但周日被国防部部长级官员贝洛·马塔瓦莱带去见总统，为他们重返APC铺平道路。卡加拉透露了与总统会面时发生的情况，他说他们尚未与APC团聚，但应邀出席了与总统的会议，以解释他们的立场和危机的起源。“我们是应邀前往总统别墅的。最初，我们中的一些人试图拒绝，但后来我们同意接受邀请，以示对总统的尊重，”卡加拉说。他补充说，蒂努布解释说他邀请他们是为了听取他们的说法，因为他收到了不同版本的发生情况。“总统说他邀请我们是为了听取真正发生了什么，因为他听到了不同版本的故事，”他说。卡加拉重申，议员们尚未改变离开APC的决定，坚持说他们没有告诉总统他们已经重返该党。“甚至总统都知道我们已经离开了该党，我们没有告诉他我们已经回来了，”他说，并补充说他们向总统蒂努布简要介绍了他们所描述的遭受的不公，并补充说总统承诺邀请另一派系与他们会面以找到解决危机的办法。关于重返APC的可能性，卡加拉说这个决定超出了个别议员的权限，强调他们的选民对此有发言权。“我们的人民有最终决定权。我们正在努力让他们的声音被听到，”他说。他还坚持认为他们的立场没有改变：必须果断解决影响其选区的安全问题。“解决我们重返APC的权利问题甚至没有出现。最初，我们面对州长劳瓦尔，要求他振作起来解决不安全问题，我们仍然坚持这一点。“如果我们同意对不安全问题保持沉默，我们就会被平等对待。但我们进行了抵抗，我们告诉总统先生，在不安全问题上需要做更多工作。他向我们保证他会做得更多。我们需要我们的人民生存；支付我们的权利只是次要问题，”他说。卡加拉还指责州长道达·劳瓦尔未能按照预期采取行动，以补充联邦政府在该州应对不安全问题的努力。他驳斥了州议会一些成员声称政府在解决不安全问题上取得了89%的成功的说法，称这个数字是虚假的。“州议会中的那些成员只是宣传政府在安全问题上取得了89%的成功，这是一个赤裸裸的谎言，”他说。卡加拉进一步声称州政府没有采取足够措施来解决日益恶化的安全局势。他透露，总统蒂努布已表示打算邀请州长劳瓦尔和议员们举行会议，并补充说这就是他们避免就此事发表进一步公开评论的原因。“州长劳瓦尔在不安全问题上什么都没做，看看这种威胁的增长速度。但总统说他会邀请州长和我们。这就是为什么我们不打算说任何话，因为我们不知道对此该说什么，”卡加拉说。APC州审计员和马塔瓦莱政治常设委员会新闻秘书马拉姆·优素福·伊德里斯·古绍表示，部长采取措施将议员们带到总统博拉·蒂努布面前，作为加强该党以迎接选举努力的一部分。

https://dailytrust.com/zamfara-adc-crisi.summary: A governorship aspirant of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) in Zamfara State, Mahdi Aliyu Mohammed, has petitioned the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) over an alleged plot to prepare and submit a backdated report of the party’s governorship primary election. https://dailytrust.com/zamfara-adc-crisi.summary_zh: 非洲民主大会党（ADC）在扎姆法拉州州长职位竞选人马赫迪·阿里尤·穆罕默德已就据称准备并提交该党州长初选选举的回溯报告的阴谋向独立国家选举委员会（INEC）提出申诉。马赫迪敦促INEC拒绝任何暗示另一场初选于2026年5月28日举行的所谓报告，并依赖其原始监督报告。
https://dailytrust.com/zamfara-adc-crisi.body: A governorship aspirant of the African Democratic Congress (ADC) in Zamfara State, Mahdi Aliyu Mohammed, has petitioned the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) over an alleged plot to prepare and submit a backdated report of the party’s governorship primary election. Mahdi urged INEC to reject any purported report suggesting that another primary was held on May 28, 2026, and to rely on its original monitoring report. In a petition dated October 19, 2026, and addressed to the INEC chairman at the commission’s headquarters in Abuja, counsel to the aspirant alleged that some party members, in collaboration with some of the aspirants, were planning to submit a report to facilitate the substitution of his name with that of another aspirant as the winner. The petition described the alleged plan as an attempt to undermine the outcome of the May 22 primary and mislead the electoral commission. According to the petition, the ADC conducted its governorship primary at Command Hotel, Gusau, on May 22, in accordance with the party’s guidelines and the electoral timetable. It further stated that officials from INEC’s national headquarters and Zamfara State office monitored the exercise, during which Mahdi allegedly secured the majority of votes cast by accredited voters under the direct-primary process. The legal representative claimed that INEC had prepared and submitted an official monitoring report to its headquarters, adding that a Certified True Copy (CTC) of the document had been obtained from the commission. The petition said the report confirmed the date of the primary and Mahdi’s emergence as the winner. It also argued that no subsequent ADC governorship primary had been scheduled, formally notified to INEC or monitored by the commission in Zamfara State after the May 22 exercise. The petition alleged that a faction within the party intended to present another report as authentic to pave the way for substitution of the party’s governorship candidate. Citing provisions of the Electoral Act 2026 and the Penal Code, the petition urged the commission to reject any purported report inconsistent with its original monitoring records. Mahdi’s legal representative asked INEC to preserve and rely on the original monitoring report already in its custody and reject any subsequently submitted document. https://dailytrust.com/zamfara-adc-crisi.body_zh: 非洲民主大会党（ADC）在赞法拉州州长职位竞选人马赫迪·阿里尤·穆罕默德已就据称准备并提交该党州长初选的倒填日期报告的阴谋向独立国家选举委员会（INEC）提出申诉。马赫迪敦促INEC拒绝任何暗示另一场初选于2026年5月28日举行的所谓报告，并依赖其原始监督报告。在一份日期为2026年10月19日并致INEC主席、地址为阿布贾委员会总部的申诉中，竞选人的律师声称一些党员与部分竞选人合作，正计划提交一份报告以便将其姓名替换为另一名竞选人的姓名作为获胜者。该申诉将所谓计划描述为试图破坏5月22日初选的结果并误导选举委员会。根据申诉，ADC于5月22日在古绍的Command Hotel按照该党的指导方针和选举时间表举行了其州长初选。它进一步指出，来自INEC国家总部和赞法拉州办公室的官员监督了该活动，在此期间马赫迪据称在直接初选过程中获得了经认证选民投出的多数票。法律代表声称INEC已准备并向其总部提交了官方监督报告，并补充说已从委员会获得了该文件的经认证真实副本（CTC）。申诉称该报告确认了初选日期和马赫迪作为获胜者的出现。它还辩称，在5月22日活动之后，没有安排后续的ADC州长初选、正式通知INEC或由委员会在赞法拉州监督。该申诉声称党内一个派系打算提交另一份报告作为真实报告，以便为替换该党州长候选人铺平道路。引用2026年选举法和刑法典的规定，申诉敦促委员会拒绝任何与其原始监督记录不一致的所谓报告。马赫迪的法律代表要求INEC保存并依赖其保管的原始监督报告，并拒绝任何随后提交的文件。尼日利亚人现在可以投资250万奈拉购买优质域名并获利约1700万至2500万奈拉。所有收益以美元支付。与其好奇，不如点击此处了解它如何运作。加入Daily Trust WhatsApp社区以快速获取您周围的新闻和事件

https://dailytrust.com/ndc-petitions-njc.summary: The Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) has called on the National Judicial Council (NJC) and the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to investigate a court ruling that displaced its candidate for the Gwale Federal Constituency in Kano State. The party alleged that its officials were not invited to testify in a suit challenging its candidate-selection process before the Federal High Court in Kano, while questioning the authenticity of documents presented in connection with the disputed nomination.
https://dailytrust.com/ndc-petitions-njc.summary_zh: 尼日利亚民主大会党（NDC）呼吁国家司法委员会（NJC）和独立国家选举委员会（INEC）调查一项法院裁决，该裁决取代了其在卡诺州瓜莱联邦选区的候选人。该党声称，其官员未被邀请在联邦高等法院卡诺分院审理的一起挑战其候选人遴选程序的诉讼中作证，同时质疑与有争议的提名相关的所提交文件的真实性。
https://dailytrust.com/ndc-petitions-njc.body: The Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) has called on the National Judicial Council (NJC) and the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to investigate a court ruling that displaced its candidate for the Gwale Federal Constituency in Kano State. The party alleged that its officials were not invited to testify in a suit challenging its candidate-selection process before the Federal High Court in Kano, while questioning the authenticity of documents presented in connection with the disputed nomination. The Chairman of the party in Gwale Local Government Area, Dr. Naziru Yusuf Abdullahi, made the call during a press briefing at the party’s headquarters on Sunday. He stated that the party conducted a consensus and affirmation exercise on May 29, 2026, during which its candidates for various elective positions were endorsed in the presence of representatives from relevant agencies. Abdullahi noted that officials from INEC, the Nigeria Police Force, the Department of State Services (DSS), and the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps (NSCDC) monitored the exercise. He listed the party’s endorsed candidates as Peter Obi for President, Aminu Abdussalam for Governor, Nasir Yusuf Gawuna for Senate, and Aminu Abdullahi for the House of Assembly, while identifying Dr. Muhammad Hamisu as the candidate for the Gwale Federal Constituency seat. According to him, the party subsequently continued its activities without receiving any official communication indicating that the candidates endorsed during the exercise had been replaced. However, he explained that the party later learned of a court case instituted by one Abdulmajid Hamisu against INEC and the NDC, which resulted in a ruling against Dr. Muhammad Hamisu. Abdullahi faulted the proceedings, alleging that neither he nor other party officials involved in the affirmation exercise were invited to clarify how the candidate was selected. He added that the chairman and secretary of the affirmation committee could have provided evidence regarding the process but were denied the opportunity. The chairman maintained that documents signed during the May 29 exercise, which were also endorsed by representatives of monitoring agencies, supported the party’s position. In separate verifying affidavits filed in a Federal High Court case involving Hon. Barr. Ismail Idris Sani, the NDC, and INEC, the party’s Kano State Chairman, Hussaini Isa Mairiga, and State Secretary, Prof. Salisu Mohammed Tudunkaya, also challenged a disputed letter dated June 15, 2026, purportedly containing the party’s list of candidates for the 2027 elections. The two officials stated that they neither signed nor authorized the issuance of the disputed letter, adding that its letterhead, logo, formatting, and signatures differed from those on the party’s official correspondence. They identified a separate candidate-submission letter dated June 15, 2026—acknowledged by INEC’s Kano office on the same date—as the authentic document. The affidavits highlighted that the disputed letter lacked the valid INEC acknowledgment stamp and differed significantly from the genuine document in presentation and authentication. (Note: The assertions in the affidavits represent the officials’ claims before the court and do not independently establish legal forgery.) Abdullahi urged INEC, the police, the DSS, and other relevant security agencies to investigate the matter, reiterating that the party remains committed to rule of law and peaceful political engagement. He also called on the NJC to review the conduct of the presiding judge who delivered the ruling, alleging that the court failed to adequately consider the party’s account of the primary process. “We are law-abiding citizens. We respect the laws of the Federal Republic of Nigeria and remain peaceful,” he said, urging party members to stay calm while the matter is pursued through legal channels.
https://dailytrust.com/ndc-petitions-njc.title_zh: NDC就法院裁决替换其在卡诺州候选人一事向NJC和INEC提出申诉
https://dailytrust.com/ndc-petitions-njc.body_zh: 尼日利亚民主大会党（NDC）呼吁国家司法委员会（NJC）和独立国家选举委员会（INEC）调查一项法院裁决，该裁决取代了其在卡诺州瓜莱联邦选区的候选人。该党声称，其官员未被邀请在联邦高等法院卡诺分院审理的一起质疑其候选人遴选程序的诉讼中作证，同时质疑与有争议的提名相关的所提交文件的真实性。该党瓜莱地方政府区主席纳齐鲁·优素福·阿卜杜拉希博士周日在该党总部举行的新闻发布会上发出了这一呼吁。他表示，该党于2026年5月29日进行了共识和确认活动，其各项选举职位的候选人在相关机构代表在场的情况下获得认可。阿卜杜拉希指出，来自INEC、尼日利亚警察部队、国家安全局（DSS）以及尼日利亚安全和民防部队（NSCDC）的官员监督了该活动。他列出了该党获得认可的候选人，包括总统候选人彼得·奥比、州长候选人阿米努·阿卜杜萨拉姆、参议院候选人纳西尔·优素福·加乌纳以及州议会候选人阿米努·阿卜杜拉希，同时确定穆罕默德·哈米苏博士为瓜莱联邦选区席位的候选人。据他介绍，该党随后继续开展活动，没有收到任何官方函件表明在该活动中获得认可的候选人已被替换。然而，他解释说，该党后来得知一名叫阿卜杜勒马吉德·哈米苏的人针对INEC和NDC提起的诉讼，该诉讼导致针对穆罕默德·哈米苏博士的裁决。阿卜杜拉希指责诉讼程序，声称他和其他参与确认活动的党官员均未被邀请澄清候选人是如何遴选的。他补充说，确认委员会的主席和秘书本可以提供有关该过程的证据，但他们被剥夺了这一机会。该主席坚持认为，在5月29日活动中签署的文件——这些文件也得到了监督机构代表的认可——支持该党的立场。在涉及Hon. Barr. Ismail Idris Sani、NDC和INEC的联邦高等法院案件中提交的单独核实宣誓书中，该党卡诺州主席侯赛尼·伊萨·迈里加和州秘书萨利苏·穆罕默德·图敦卡亚教授也对一封据称载有该党2027年选举候选人名单的有争议的2026年6月15日信件提出质疑。这两名官员表示，他们既没有签署也没有授权发出这封有争议的信件，并补充说其信头、标志、格式和签名与该党官方函件的不同。他们确定另一封日期为2026年6月15日的候选人提交信件——该信件在同一天得到INEC卡诺办公室的确认——为真实文件。这些宣誓书强调，有争议的信件缺乏有效的INEC确认印章，并且在呈现和认证方面与真实文件存在重大差异。（注：宣誓书中的主张代表官员们在法庭上的陈述，并不独立确立法律伪造。）阿卜杜拉希敦促INEC、警察、DSS和其他相关安全机构调查此事，重申该党致力于法治和和平的政治参与。他还呼吁NJC审查作出该裁决的主审法官的行为，指称法院未能充分考虑该党对初选过程的陈述。“我们是守法的公民。我们尊重尼日利亚联邦共和国的法律并保持和平，”他说，并敦促党员在通过法律渠道处理此事期间保持冷静。

https://dailytrust.com/13-days-after-fct.summary: P arents of primary and secondary school pupils in the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) have expressed concern over the ongoing teachers’ strike, warning that the continued closure of public schools could expose children to social vices and disrupt their education. Notwithstanding the directive, checks by Abuja Metro showed that learning activities across public primary and secondary schools in the territory remain grounded as teachers are yet to return to work.
https://dailytrust.com/13-days-after-fct.summary_zh: 联邦首都区（FCT）中小学学生的家长对正在进行的教师罢工表示担忧，警告说公立学校持续关闭可能使儿童暴露于社会恶习并中断他们的教育。尽管有指令，但阿布贾都市报的检查显示，该地区公立中小学的学习活动仍处于停滞状态，因为教师尚未返回工作岗位。
https://dailytrust.com/13-days-after-fct.body: P arents of primary and secondary school pupils in the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) have expressed concern over the ongoing teachers’ strike, warning that the continued closure of public schools could expose children to social vices and disrupt their education. Abuja Metro recalls that teachers in public primary and secondary schools across the six area councils of the FCT embarked on an indefinite strike on Oct. 7 following a directive by the FCT chapter of the Nigeria Labour Congress (NLC), led by Comrade Stephen Knabayi. In a communiqué issued at the end of its State Executive Council (SEC) meeting held at the Labour House in Abuja on October 6, 2026, the NLC directed teachers under the Nigeria Union of Teachers (NUT) to withdraw their services over the alleged failure of the FCT Administration to address the vacancy clause and other outstanding demands. Following the strike action, FCT Minister Nyesom Wike ordered the six FCT area council chairmen to enforce the “no work, no pay” policy against striking teachers and local government workers that failed to report to work. Wike described the strike as politically motivated, warning that the administration would not tolerate such action. Notwithstanding the directive, checks by Abuja Metro showed that learning activities across public primary and secondary schools in the territory remain grounded as teachers are yet to return to work. Meanwhile, parents who spoke to our reporter on Monday expressed worry that the prolonged strike had disrupted their children’s academic activities, leaving many pupils and students at home without access to formal learning. A parent, Mrs Hannatu Bawa, said the strike had deprived her children of the opportunity to attend school, adding that her two children in secondary school in Gwagwalada had remained at home since the industrial action began. She said the children had taken advantage of the school closure to spend much of their time playing football rather than studying. “In fact, the only time I see them is when they are hungry. The moment they eat, they sneak out of the house to play football instead of being in school. So, you can see the effect of the ongoing strike,” she said. Another parent, Mr Gbenga Adekunle, a resident of Kuje Area Council, said the prolonged closure of schools had negatively affected his children, who now spend much of their time playing around the neighbourhood. He said it was heartbreaking to see his children remain at home while their counterparts in private schools continued with their studies. Adekunle urged the government to intervene urgently and address the teachers’ demands in the interest of parents and the future of the children. “Sometimes, I have to go out looking for my children, including checking my neighbours’ houses, before they return home. You can see that we are in the political campaign period, and I am disturbed because I do not want these children to end up joining political thugs,” he said. He called on the FCT Administration to prioritise education and resolve the dispute, warning that repeated strikes could undermine the quality and reputation of education in the nation’s capital. “Let the FCT Minister, Nyesom Wike, prioritise the education sector in the territory. It is a shame that Abuja, which is the nation’s capital, is always experiencing strikes,” he said. Similarly, Mr Ibrahim Abdullahi, a parent and resident of Kwali Area Council, said he could not afford to enrol his children in a private school, leaving them with no alternative but to remain at home during the strike. He urged the government to prioritise the welfare of teachers, whom he said played a critical role in educating and preparing children for the future. Abdullahi said he was disturbed by the sight of his children playing around every morning instead of attending classes, warning that prolonged idleness could expose them to antisocial behaviour.
https://dailytrust.com/13-days-after-fct.body_zh: 联邦首都区（FCT）的中小学学生家长对正在进行的教师罢工表示担忧，警告称公立学校持续关闭可能使儿童接触到社会恶习并中断他们的教育。阿布贾都市报回顾，联邦首都区六个区委员会的公立中小学教师在尼日利亚劳工大会（NLC）联邦首都区分会由同志Stephen Knabayi领导下发出指示后，于10月7日开始了无限期罢工。在2026年10月6日在阿布贾劳工之家举行的州执行委员会（SEC）会议结束后发布的公报中，尼日利亚劳工大会指示尼日利亚教师工会（NUT）下的教师撤回服务，原因是联邦首都区政府未能解决职位空缺条款和其他未决诉求。在罢工行动之后，联邦首都区部长Nyesom Wike命令六个联邦首都区委员会主席对罢工教师和未上班的地方政府工作人员执行“不工作，不付薪”政策。Wike称此次罢工具有政治动机，警告称政府不会容忍此类行动。尽管有该指示，但阿布贾都市报的检查显示，该地区公立中小学的学习活动仍处于停滞状态，因为教师尚未返回工作岗位。与此同时，周一接受本报记者采访的家长们表达了担忧，认为旷日持久的罢工中断了他们孩子的学术活动，使许多小学生和中学生留在家中无法获得正规学习。一位家长Hannatu Bawa夫人说，罢工剥夺了她的孩子上学的机会，并补充说她在Gwagwalada上中学的两个孩子自罢工开始以来一直待在家里。她说孩子们利用学校关闭的机会，把大部分时间花在踢足球上而不是学习。“事实上，我看到他们的唯一时间是他们饿的时候。他们一吃完饭，就溜出家门去踢足球，而不是待在学校。所以，你可以看到正在进行的罢工的影响，”她说。另一位家长Gbenga Adekunle先生是Kuje区委员会的居民，他说学校长期关闭对他的孩子产生了负面影响，他们现在大部分时间都在社区周围玩耍。他说，看到自己的孩子待在家里，而私立学校的同龄人继续学习，这令人心碎。Adekunle敦促政府紧急干预并满足教师的要求，以符合家长和孩子未来的利益。“有时，我不得不出去寻找我的孩子，包括检查邻居的房子，然后他们才回家。你可以看到我们正处于政治竞选期，我很不安，因为我不希望这些孩子最终加入政治暴徒，”他说。他呼吁联邦首都区政府优先考虑教育并解决争端，警告称反复罢工可能破坏国家首都教育的质量和声誉。“让联邦首都区部长Nyesom Wike优先考虑该地区的教育部门。阿布贾作为国家首都却总是经历罢工，这是一种耻辱，”他说。同样，Ibrahim Abdullahi先生是一位Kwali区委员会的家长和居民，他说他负担不起让孩子上私立学校的费用，导致他们在罢工期间别无选择只能待在家里。他敦促政府优先考虑教师的福利，他说教师在教育孩子和为他们的未来做准备方面发挥着关键作用。Abdullahi说，他对每天早上看到孩子四处玩耍而不是上课的情景感到不安，警告称长期无所事事可能使他们接触到反社会行为。

https://dailytrust.com/fcta-launches-int.title: FCTA launches integrity test after building collapse in Abuja
https://dailytrust.com/fcta-launches-int.summary: The Federal Capital Territory Administration (FCTA) has engaged a consultant to conduct an integrity test on a residential building that partially collapsed in Wuse 2, Abuja, to determine the cause of the incident and assess the stability of the remaining structure.
https://dailytrust.com/fcta-launches-int.summary_zh: 联邦首都区管理局（FCTA）已聘请一名顾问，对阿布贾武塞2区一栋部分倒塌的住宅楼进行完整性测试，以确定事故原因并评估剩余结构的稳定性。
https://dailytrust.com/fcta-launches-int.body: The Federal Capital Territory Administration (FCTA) has engaged a consultant to conduct an integrity test on a residential building that partially collapsed in Wuse 2, Abuja, to determine the cause of the incident and assess the stability of the remaining structure. The incident occurred on Saturday afternoon at a residential development on Plot 496, Cadastral Zone A08, Wuse 2 District, with no casualty recorded. The Department of Development Control of the Abuja Metropolitan Management Council (AMMC) disclosed this in a statement yesterday, adding that it had commenced the evacuation of debris from the affected site to ensure safety and facilitate further assessment. The department said the integrity test would establish the possible cause of the partial collapse and determine whether the remaining structure was stable. It added that the consultant would provide professional recommendations on the appropriate steps to be taken following the assessment. According to the department, further action on the affected building would be guided by the outcome of the technical assessment and recommendations of the professionals involved. https://dailytrust.com/wike-wants-german.body: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has sought development partnerships with German cities in agriculture, information and communications technology (ICT) and youth skills acquisition to boost economic growth in Abuja. The minister said the FCT Administration was committed to transforming Abuja into a world-class capital capable of competing with global cities such as Berlin, Munich and Washington, D.C. With the mandate to change the narrative, security and the environment have improved, and road infrastructure is being actively delivered,” he said. Things may be harsh now for a short while, but in the long run, the people will reap the benefits,” he said. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.title: NNPC Cuts Exploration Spending by 87%, Gas Flare Bill Falls to N499bn
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.summary: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) slashed additions to its exploration and evaluation assets by 87.7 per cent to N78.8 billion in 2025, from N640.5 billion in 2024, according to its latest Annual Financial Report (AFS).
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.summary_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司有限公司（NNPC）将其勘探和评估资产的增加额削减87.7%至2025年的788亿奈拉，2024年为6405亿奈拉，根据其最新的年度财务报告（AFS）。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.body: The Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited (NNPC) slashed additions to its exploration and evaluation assets by 87.7 per cent to N78.8 billion in 2025, from N640.5 billion in 2024, according to its latest Annual Financial Report (AFS). In the same vein, the national oil company’s gas flaring charges during the period under consideration fell by 62.2 per cent from N1.32 trillion in 2024 to N499 billion in 2025, the financial report indicated. However, the decline in exploration funding may not be unconnected with the slowdown in the search for hydrocarbons in underexplored areas, including the Chad Basin, Benue Trough, Bida Basin and Sokoto Basin, all in the northern part of Nigeria. Despite billions of naira committed to the programme, projects such as Kolmani, straddling Bauchi and Gombe states; drilling and appraisal activities such as the Wadi-2 exploratory well in Borno and exploration activities and seismic data gathering in Nasarawa state have yet to reach breakthrough levels. To compound the matter. President Bola Tinubu’s Executive Order 9 of 2026, has now suspended NNPC’s collection and management of the 30 per cent Frontier Exploration Fund (FEF) and ordered that the money be remitted directly to the Federation Account for distribution among the federal, state and local governments. On gas flaring, the group’s total charges declined to N499 billion from N1.32 trillion in 2024. The amount comprised N247.8 billion in flare fees, down from N708.6 billion, and N251.2 billion in penalties for flaring above approved limits, compared with N610.4 billion previously. The fees are statutory charges based on limits approved by the Nigerian Upstream Petroleum Regulatory Commission (NUPRC) under Section 104 of the Petroleum Industry Act (PIA). Despite the reduction, penalties accounted for approximately half of the group’s total gas flaring charges. At the parent company level, gas flaring charges dropped to N317.3 billion from N1.04 trillion. The decline came as NNPC paid N11.56 trillion to settle royalties, rentals and gas flare obligations during the year, more than four times the N2.83 trillion recorded in 2024. The reduction in outstanding liabilities also reflected a N1.18 trillion write-back of excess provisions from earlier years. Consequently, the group’s outstanding liability under the category fell by 86.2 per cent to N1.27 trillion from N9.21 trillion. Royalty charges, however, increased by 4.1 per cent to N4.66 trillion, while the levy payable to the Niger Delta Development Commission (NDDC) rose by 29.2 per cent to N514.7 billion. Overall, total additions across intangible asset classes fell by 88.6 per cent to N79 billion, from N692.7 billion in 2024, while additions to mineral rights were nil, compared with N46.3 billion a year earlier. Mineral rights represent rights associated with exploring for or extracting oil and gas from specified acreage. In Nigeria’s petroleum industry, these rights are linked to legally recognised entitlements to undertake petroleum operations, subject to applicable laws, lease terms and regulatory approvals. The absence of additions means NNPC recorded no new expenditure in that asset category during the year. The report also showed that mineral rights valued at N16.4 billion relating to oil mining leases 64 and 66 were removed after being fully impaired. An impairment occurs when an asset’s recorded value is no longer considered recoverable under applicable accounting rules. The report also disclosed lower spending on selected operational activities, as rig site and stimulation expenses declined to N2.9 billion from N16.5 billion earlier recorded by the national oil company. Besides, the AFS showed that allocated technical and production costs fell to N144.4 billion from N489.6 billion, while crude handling and port charges declined to N1.06 trillion from N1.52 trillion.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.title_zh: NNPC将勘探支出削减87%，天然气燃烧账单降至N499bn
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/n.body_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司有限公司（NNPC）将其勘探和评价资产的增量削减了87.7%，从2024年的N640.5 billion降至2025年的N78.8 billion，根据其最新的年度财务报告（AFS）。同样，国家石油公司在所考虑期间的气体燃烧费用下降了62.2%，从2024年的N1.32 trillion降至2025年的N499 billion，该财务报告显示。然而，勘探资金的下降可能与在未充分勘探地区寻找碳氢化合物的放缓有关，包括乍得盆地、贝努埃槽谷、比达盆地和索科托盆地，这些地区均位于尼日利亚北部。尽管该计划投入了数十亿奈拉，但诸如横跨包奇州和贡贝州的Kolmani等项目；在博尔诺州的Wadi-2勘探井等钻探和评估活动以及在纳萨拉瓦州的勘探活动和地震数据收集尚未达到突破水平。更糟糕的是，博拉·蒂努布总统2026年的第9号行政命令现已暂停NNPC对30%的边境勘探基金（FEF）的收取和管理，并命令将资金直接汇入联邦账户，以便在联邦、州和地方政府之间分配。在气体燃烧方面，该集团的总费用从2024年的N1.32 trillion下降至N499 billion。该金额包括N247.8 billion的燃烧费，从N708.6 billion下降，以及N251.2 billion的超过批准限额燃烧的罚款，而之前为N610.4 billion。这些费用是基于尼日利亚上游石油监管委员会（NUPRC）根据石油工业法（PIA）第104条批准的限额的法定费用。尽管有所减少，但罚款约占该集团气体燃烧总费用的近一半。在母公司层面，气体燃烧费用从N1.04 trillion降至N317.3 billion。这种下降是因为NNPC在当年支付了N11.56 trillion来结算特许权使用费、租金和气体燃烧义务，是2024年记录的N2.83 trillion的四倍多。未清偿负债的减少还反映了从早期年度超额准备金中转回的N1.18 trillion。因此，该集团该类别下的未清偿负债下降了86.2%，从N9.21 trillion降至N1.27 trillion。然而，特许权使用费增加了4.1%至N4.66 trillion，而应付给尼日尔三角洲发展委员会（NDDC）的征费增加了29.2%至N514.7 billion。总体而言，无形资产类别的总增量下降了88.6%，从2024年的N692.7 billion降至N79 billion，而矿产权的增量为零，而前一年为N46.3 billion。矿产权代表与在指定区域勘探或开采石油和天然气相关的权利。在尼日利亚石油工业中，这些权利与依法认可的从事石油作业的权利相关，须遵守适用的法律、租赁条款和监管批准。没有增量意味着NNPC在当年该资产类别中没有记录新的支出。该报告还显示，与石油采矿租约64和66相关的价值N16.4 billion的矿产权在完全减值后被移除。当资产的记录价值根据适用的会计规则不再被视为可收回时，就会发生减值。该报告还披露了对选定运营活动的较低支出，因为钻井现场和刺激费用从国家石油公司之前记录的N16.5 billion降至N2.9 billion。此外，AFS显示分配的技术和生产成本从N489.6 billion降至N144.4 billion，而原油处理和港口费用从N1.52 trillion降至N1.06 trillion。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/s.body: The President of the Surveyors Council of Nigeria (SURCON), Moshood Akinwande, has reaffirmed that the regulation of the surveying profession in Nigeria is governed by federal legislation, emphasising that the Council is the statutory body vested with the responsibility of registering surveyors and regulating the practice of the surveying profession throughout the Federation. He made the clarification in Abeokuta, Ogun State, during his two-day official working visit to the state, at the invitation of the Chairman of the Nigerian Institution of Surveyors (NIS), Ogun State Branch, Surveyor Abiodun Liadi. Speaking during the visit, the SURCON President explained that the regulation of the surveying profession falls within the legislative competence of the Federal Government, through an Act of the National Assembly. He stressed that SURCON is statutorily empowered to register qualified surveyors, regulate professional practice nationwide, and exercise disciplinary control over practitioners who contravene established professional standards. He further clarified that the Council’s regulatory authority extends to the surveying profession in all its branches and ramifications, across the 36 states of the Federation and the Federal Capital Territory, Abuja. Akinwande emphasised that the Council’s statutory mandate is to ensure professional competence, ethical conduct and compliance with applicable federal legislation and professional standards throughout Nigeria. He also advised members of the public, particularly prospective land purchasers, property developers and investors, to engage the services of duly registered surveyors when acquiring landed properties or undertaking survey-related transactions. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/f.body: The federal government has pledged to intensify efforts to promote Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) as a cheaper alternative fuel for transportation, with a renewed focus on accelerating the rollout of 1 million CNG-powered vehicles across the country. To this end, the Minister of State Petroleum Resources (Gas), Ekperikpe Ekpo, has tasked the leadership of the Presidential Initiative on Compressed Natural Gas and Electric Vehicles (Pi-CNG & EV) and the Decade of Gas Secretariat to focus on critical interventions. In a statement in Abuja, the minister urged the Pi-CNG & EV office and the secretariat to step up investments, expand CNG infrastructure and strengthen programmes to drive nationwide adoption. Ekpo gave the directive in Abuja while receiving progress updates from the two bodies, stressing the need to translate the federal government’s auto CNG policy into tangible benefits for Nigerians in the form of cheaper transport fares. He said the drive had become imperative following the removal of petrol subsidy and the need to provide Nigerians with a more affordable and environmentally friendly alternative for transportation, in line with the aspirations of President Bola Tinubu. In his remarks, the Executive Chairman/CEO of Pi-CNG & EV, Mr. Ismaeel Ahmed, said the initiative would step up investments and programmes to expand CNG infrastructure and increase vehicle conversions nationwide and lead to cheaper transport fares for millions of Nigerians. Ahmed explained that the joint industry market study completed by the decade of gas secretariat provided a framework for accelerating rollout, tracking progress, identifying gaps and strengthening implementation efforts to accelerate the adoption of CNG as a transportation fuel. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/20/f.body_zh: 联邦政府已承诺加大力度推广压缩天然气（CNG）作为交通领域更廉价的替代燃料，并重新重点加快在全国推广100万辆CNG动力汽车。为此，石油资源国务部长（天然气）埃克佩里克佩·埃克波已责成总统压缩天然气和电动汽车倡议（Pi-CNG & EV）领导层以及天然气十年秘书处专注于关键干预措施。在阿布贾发表的一份声明中，部长敦促Pi-CNG & EV办公室和秘书处加大投资、扩大CNG基础设施并加强推动全国采用的方案。埃克波在阿布贾接收这两个机构进展更新时下达了这一指示，强调需要将联邦政府的汽车CNG政策转化为尼日利亚人的切实利益，即更便宜的交通费用。他说，在取消汽油补贴之后，这一举措变得势在必行，需要为尼日利亚人提供更负担得起且环境友好的交通替代方案，这符合总统博拉·蒂努布的愿景。在他的讲话中，Pi-CNG & EV执行主席兼首席执行官伊斯梅尔·艾哈迈德先生表示，该倡议将加大投资和方案力度，以扩大CNG基础设施并增加全国车辆改装，从而为数百万尼日利亚人带来更便宜的交通费用。艾哈迈德解释说，由天然气十年秘书处完成联合行业市场研究为加快推广、跟踪进展、找出差距和加强实施工作提供了框架，以加速采用CNG作为交通燃料。THISDAY成立于1995年1月22日，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕克里克路35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都特区及世界各地设有办事处。它是尼日利亚最具权威性的新闻媒体，在所有平台上为政治、商业、专业和外交精英以及更广泛的中产阶级提供服务，同时作为新思想、文化和技术与有抱负者和千禧一代的交汇点。该报纸是一种公共信托，致力于追求真相和理性，涵盖从突发新闻到政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育、社区以及人与社会交汇点的一系列问题。您可以通过hello@thisdaylive.com与我们联系，或访问我们的联系页面。

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.summary: The Rivers State House of Assembly has reversed its earlier decision declaring the seats of three lawmakers loyal to Governor Siminalayi Fubara vacant. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.summary_zh: 里弗斯州议会已撤销其早先宣布三位忠于州长Siminalayi Fubara的议员席位空缺的决定。这些议员是2023年10月30日因政治危机而被停职的四名成员之一，该危机将议会分裂成忠于Wike先生和Fubara先生的派系。最近的决定是在重新努力调和Wike先生和Fubara先生之后做出的，此前双方已敌对三年多，反复扰乱里弗斯州治理。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Rivers State House of Assembly has reversed its earlier decision declaring the seats of three lawmakers loyal to Governor Siminalayi Fubara vacant. The Assembly took the decision a day after FCT Minister, Nyesom Wike, led lawmakers and the state’s 23 local government chairpersons to a reconciliation meeting with the governor in Port Harcourt. The lawmakers are Timothy Oruibienimigha, representing Opobo/Nkoro Constituency; Victor Jumbo , representing Bonny Constituency; and Sokari Goodboy Sokari, representing Ahoada West Constituency. Martins Wachukwu, a media aide to the speaker, announced the development in a statement posted on Facebook on Monday. According to the statement, the lawmakers apologised to the House for failing to resume legislative duties after their suspension was lifted in December 2023. They attributed their continued absence to their alleged failure to receive official correspondence informing them that the suspension had been lifted following a presidential intervention, the statement said. The lawmakers were among four members suspended on 30 October 2023 amid the political crisis that divided the assembly into factions loyal to Mr Wike and Mr Fubara. The statement said in Monday’s plenary, lawmakers debated the appeals and supported the request to rescind the earlier resolution declaring the seats vacant. Mr Amaewhule said, “Investigations indicated that the three lawmakers might not have received the correspondence notifying them of the lifting of their suspension,” the statement added. The lawmakers subsequently voted in favour of reversing the declaration, allowing their colleagues to return to the Assembly, according to the statement. The latest decision comes amid renewed efforts to reconcile Mr Wike and Mr Fubara after more than three years of political hostilities that have repeatedly disrupted governance in Rivers State. The political crisis in Rivers State began in 2023, months after Governor Fubara succeeded Mr Wike as governor. The disagreement between the former allies escalated into a struggle for control of the state’s political structures, including the House of Assembly. In October 2023, amid an impeachment attempt against Mr Fubara by lawmakers loyal to Mr Wike, the Assembly split into two factions. An overwhelming majority of 27 lawmakers backed Mr Wike, while four supported the governor. Edison Ehie, who led the four-member faction loyal to Mr Fubara, obtained a court order allowing the group to continue legislative proceedings and subsequently emerged as speaker of the factional Assembly. Mr Ehie resigned as speaker and as a member of the Assembly following a peace deal brokered by President Bola Tinubu in December 2023. Mr Fubara later appointed him chief of staff. In May 2024, Mr Jumbo emerged as speaker of the pro-Fubara faction after Mr Ehie’s departure. The faction continued to hold sittings and pass legislation, including considering budget proposals and screening commissioner nominees, while the Amaewhule-led faction also conducted legislative business. The legal battle over the Assembly’s leadership later shifted in favour of the Wike-backed lawmakers. In July 2024, the Court of Appeal reinstated the 27 lawmakers and recognised Martin Amaewhule as speaker. The Supreme Court subsequently ruled in February 2025 in favour of the Amaewhule-led Assembly, restoring the lawmakers’ status as legitimate members of the legislature. The ruling also affected the legal standing of decisions taken by the rival faction. In October 2024, the Amaewhule-led Assembly declared the seats of the three lawmakers now seeking reinstatement vacant, citing their continued absence from legislative sittings. The House said it had notified the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) to conduct elections to fill the vacancies.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.title_zh: 河流州议会恢复三名亲富巴拉议员职位
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body_zh: 里弗斯州议会已撤销此前宣布三位忠于州长 Siminalayi Fubara 的议员席位空缺的决定。议会在联邦首都区部长 Nyesom Wike 带领议员和该州 23 个地方政府主席与州长在哈科特港举行和解会议一天后作出这一决定。这些议员是代表 Opobo/Nkoro 选区的 Timothy Oruibienimigha、代表 Bonny 选区的 Victor Jumbo 以及代表 Ahoada West 选区的 Sokari Goodboy Sokari。议长媒体助理 Martins Wachukwu 周一在 Facebook 上发布的一份声明中宣布了这一进展。根据声明，这些议员就未能 在 2023 年 12 月 暂停被解除后恢复立法职责向议会道歉。他们将持续缺席归因于据称未收到通知他们暂停已被总统干预解除的正式函件，声明称。这些议员是 2023 年 10 月 30 日在将议会分裂成忠于 Wike 先生和 Fubara 先生派系的政治危机中被暂停的四名成员之一。声明称，在周一的全体会议上，议员们辩论了上诉并支持撤销此前宣布席位空缺的决议。Amaewhule 先生说，“调查表明，这三位议员可能没有收到通知他们暂停被解除的函件，”声明补充说。这些议员随后投票赞成撤销该声明，允许他们的同事返回议会，根据声明。这一最新决定是在 Wike 先生和 Fubara 先生之间为期三年多的政治敌对之后重新努力和解的背景下作出的，这些敌对反复扰乱了里弗斯州的治理。里弗斯州的政治危机始于 2023 年，即 Fubara 州长接替 Wike 先生担任州长几个月后。前盟友之间的分歧升级为争夺该州政治结构控制权的斗争，包括议会。2023 年 10 月，在忠于 Wike 先生的议员试图弹劾 Fubara 先生期间，议会分裂成两个派系。27 名议员的压倒性多数支持 Wike 先生，而四名支持州长。领导忠于 Fubara 先生的四人派系的 Edison Ehie 获得法院命令，允许该团体继续立法程序，随后成为派系议会的议长。Ehie 先生在 2023 年 12 月由总统 Bola Tinubu 促成的和平协议后辞去议长和议会议员职务。Fubara 先生后来任命他为幕僚长。2024 年 5 月，在 Ehie 先生离开后，Jumbo 先生成为亲 Fubara 派系的议长。该派系继续举行会议并通过立法，包括审议预算提案和筛选专员提名人，而 Amaewhule 领导的派系也开展立法工作。关于议会领导权的法律斗争后来转向有利于 Wike 支持的议员。2024 年 7 月，上诉法院恢复了 27 名议员的职务并承认 Martin Amaewhule 为议长。最高法院随后于 2025 年 2 月作出有利于 Amaewhule 领导的议会的裁决，恢复了这些议员作为立法机关合法成员的地位。该裁决还影响了对手派系所作决定的法律地位。2024 年 10 月，Amaewhule 领导的议会宣布现在寻求恢复职位的三位议员的席位空缺，理由是他们持续缺席立法会议。议会表示已通知独立国家选举委员会（INEC）举行选举以填补空缺。

https://punchng.com/tinubu-extends-tenur.body: President Bola Tinubu has approved an 18-month extension of the tenures of the Controller-General of the Nigerian Correctional Service, Sylvester Ndidi Nwakuche, and the Comptroller-General of the Nigeria Immigration Service, Kemi Nanna Nandap. The extension means Nwakuche will remain in office until May 26, 2028, while Nandap’s tenure will end on June 30, 2028. The approval was disclosed in a statement issued on Monday by the President’s Special Adviser on Information and Strategy, Bayo Onanuga. According to the statement, the extension followed a recommendation by the Minister of Interior, Olubunmi Tunji-Ojo, to address a succession gap in both services and allow their boards sufficient time to appoint successors. “President Tinubu commended Nwakuche and Nandap for the reforms achieved under their leadership and charged them to consolidate these gains,” the statement said. Onanuga said Nwakuche was nominated by Tinubu as Controller-General of the Nigerian Correctional Service in December 2024, and his appointment was confirmed by the Senate in March 2025. Nandap was nominated as Comptroller-General of the Nigeria Immigration Service on February 21, 2024, and confirmed by the Senate on March 1, 2024. https://www.myjoyonline.com/targeted-int.summary: The Deputy Minister of Health, Dr Grace Ayensu-Danquah, has said targeted interventions have helped the Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital (KATH) in Kumasi for instance to reduce maternal deaths by 30 per cent in recent months. She described maternal mortality as Ghana’s worst-performing health indicator, with the national rate standing at 234 deaths per 100,000 live births, more than three times the World Health Organisation (WHO) target of 70 deaths per 100,000 live births by 2030.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/targeted-int.summary_zh: 卫生部副部长格雷斯·阿延苏-丹夸博士表示，针对性干预措施帮助库马西的科姆福·阿诺凯教学医院（KATH）在最近几个月将孕产妇死亡率降低了30%。她将孕产妇死亡率描述为加纳表现最差的健康指标，全国比率达到每10万活产婴儿234例死亡，是世界卫生组织（WHO）到2030年每10万活产婴儿70例死亡目标的三倍多。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/targeted-int.body: The Deputy Minister of Health, Dr Grace Ayensu-Danquah, has said targeted interventions have helped the Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital (KATH) in Kumasi for instance to reduce maternal deaths by 30 per cent in recent months. She attributed the reduction to a mentorship programme for doctors performing caesarean sections at lower-level health facilities and a virtual labour room through which specialists guided midwives remotely. Dr Ayensu-Danquah said the Ministry wanted the interventions adopted nationwide under a common plan to improve maternal healthcare. Speaking during a meeting of Parliament’s Public Accounts Committee (PAC) on Monday, October 19, 2026, Dr Ayensu-Danquah said a total of 445 maternal deaths had been recorded in Ghana by mid-year 2026, compared to a total of 419 during the same period in 2025. According to her, the slight increase is why the Ministry of Health has called for dedicated budget funding and National Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS) coverage for pregnant women's critical care. She described maternal mortality as Ghana’s worst-performing health indicator, with the national rate standing at 234 deaths per 100,000 live births, more than three times the World Health Organisation (WHO) target of 70 deaths per 100,000 live births by 2030. “Behind every number is a woman, a family,” Dr Ayensu-Danquah told the committee. She said the Ministry has identified three major challenges contributing to maternal deaths. They include the failure to identify high-risk women, particularly those with hypertension or severe anaemia, at the primary healthcare level, delays and breakdowns in the referral and ambulance system, and shortages of blood, ventilators and intensive care facilities at secondary and tertiary hospitals. Dr Ayensu-Danquah said delays in accessing emergency care often determined whether a woman survived before she reached a teaching hospital. “In critical care we speak of the golden hour, the first 60 minutes after injury. If a woman waits 48 hours for an ambulance at the primary level, the outcome is already decided,” she said. She identified early detection of anaemia as one of the measures needed to reduce maternal deaths. She also urged health workers to recognise pica, a condition characterised by cravings for non-food items such as chalk or ice, as a possible sign of an underlying health problem. Dr Ayensu-Danquah further stressed the need for high-risk pregnant women to deliver at facilities equipped to manage complications rather than at Community-based Health Planning and Services (CHPS) compounds without the required capacity. Ahead of the 2027 Budget, the Ministry is seeking a dedicated budget allocation for maternal health to address what it describes as fragmented funding from non-governmental organisations and development partners. It is also pushing for the NHIS to cover critical care for pregnant women, including intensive care, oxygen, blood and specialist interventions. The Chairperson of the Public Accounts Committee, Abena Osei-Asare, said the committee would present the Auditor-General’s performance audit report on maternal mortality when Parliament resumed sitting. She said the report’s recommendations would inform discussions on the national budget. “We will support the Ministry in speaking to the Finance Minister to ensure some dedicated level of funding is given to maternal mortality healthcare in this country,” she said. Dr Ayensu-Danquah warned that without further action, Ghana risked maintaining a high maternal mortality rate beyond 2030. “If we don’t do this, we will still be at 200-and-something in 2030. Our women are needlessly dying. Most of these deaths are preventable,” she said

https://www.myjoyonline.com/targeted-int.body_zh: 卫生部副部长格雷斯·阿延苏-丹夸博士表示，有针对性的干预措施帮助了库马西的科姆福·阿诺基教学医院（KATH），例如在最近几个月将孕产妇死亡人数减少了30%。她将这一减少归因于针对在较低级别卫生设施进行剖腹产的医生的指导计划，以及一个虚拟产房，专家通过它远程指导助产士。阿延苏-丹夸博士说，卫生部希望这些干预措施在全国范围内以一个共同计划的形式采用，以改善孕产妇保健。在2026年10月19日星期一议会公共账户委员会（PAC）会议上发言时，阿延苏-丹夸博士说，到2026年年中，加纳共记录了445例孕产妇死亡，而2025年同期共为419例。据她介绍，这一轻微增加是卫生部呼吁为孕妇危重症护理提供专用预算资金和国家健康保险计划（NHIS）覆盖的原因。她将孕产妇死亡率描述为加纳表现最差的健康指标，全国比率为每10万活产婴儿234例死亡，是世界卫生组织（WHO）到2030年每10万活产婴儿70例死亡目标的三倍多。“每个数字背后都是一个女人，一个家庭，”阿延苏-丹夸博士告诉委员会。她说，卫生部已经确定了导致孕产妇死亡的三个主要挑战。其中包括在初级保健层面未能识别高危妇女，特别是那些患有高血压或严重贫血的妇女，转诊和救护车系统的延误和故障，以及二级和三级医院的血液、呼吸机和重症护理设施短缺。阿延苏-丹夸博士说，获得紧急护理的延误往往决定了一个妇女在到达教学医院之前是否能存活。“在危重症护理中，我们谈到黄金一小时，即受伤后的前60分钟。如果一个妇女在初级层面等待救护车48小时，结果已经确定，”她说。她将贫血的早期检测确定为减少孕产妇死亡所需的措施之一。她还敦促卫生工作者认识到异食癖，这是一种以渴望非食物物品如粉笔或冰为特征的状况，可能是一种潜在健康问题的迹象。阿延苏-丹夸博士进一步强调，高危孕妇需要在配备有管理并发症能力的设施中分娩，而不是在没有所需能力的社区卫生规划和服务（CHPS）站。在2027年预算之前，卫生部正在寻求专门的孕产妇健康预算拨款，以解决它所描述的来自非政府组织和发展伙伴的分散资金问题。它还推动国家健康保险计划（NHIS）覆盖孕妇的危重症护理，包括重症护理、氧气、血液和专家干预。公共账户委员会主席阿贝娜·奥塞-阿萨雷说，委员会将在议会恢复开会时提交审计长关于孕产妇死亡率的绩效审计报告。她说，该报告的建议将为全国预算讨论提供信息。“我们将支持卫生部与财政部长对话，以确保为这个国家的孕产妇死亡率保健提供一定水平的专用资金，”她说。阿延苏-丹夸博士警告说，如果没有进一步行动，加纳可能会在2030年之后维持较高的孕产妇死亡率。“如果我们不这样做，到2030年我们仍将处于200多。我们妇女正在无谓地死亡。这些死亡大多数是可以预防的，”她说

https://leadership.ng/fifa-u-17-womens-w.title: FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup: USA Smash Records With 16-Goal Rout As Spain, China Win
https://leadership.ng/fifa-u-17-womens-w.summary: The United States set a new scoring record at the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup Morocco 2026 after thrashing Samoa, while two-time champions Spain and China PR began their campaigns with victories on Monday. The USA produced the biggest victory in FIFA World Cup history at any level, overwhelming Samoa in a one-sided encounter that also saw Maddie DiMaria become the first player to score six goals in a single match at the U-17 Women’s World Cup.
https://leadership.ng/fifa-u-17-womens-w.summary_zh: 美国在2026年摩洛哥国际足联U-17女足世界杯上创造了新的进球纪录，在大胜萨摩亚的同时，两届冠军西班牙和中国PR于周一开始了她们的征程。美国在国际足联任何级别世界杯历史上创造了最大胜利，在一场一边倒的比赛中压倒萨摩亚，这场比赛也让Maddie DiMaria成为首位在U-17女足世界杯单场比赛中打进六球的球员。
https://leadership.ng/fifa-u-17-womens-w.body: The United States set a new scoring record at the FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup Morocco 2026 after thrashing Samoa, while two-time champions Spain and China PR began their campaigns with victories on Monday. Australia and Chile, however, shared the points after battling to a 1-1 draw as Groups E and F got under way. The USA produced the biggest victory in FIFA World Cup history at any level, overwhelming Samoa in a one-sided encounter that also saw Maddie DiMaria become the first player to score six goals in a single match at the U-17 Women’s World Cup. DiMaria opened the scoring after just 62 seconds, side-footing home before Mia Corona doubled the advantage with a superb volley from a corner. DiMaria then completed the first hat-trick of the tournament with two quick goals, setting the tone for a relentless American performance. Loradana Paletta scored twice, while Grace Murray and DiMaria added further goals before Amari Manning made it nine by finishing at the far post. The United States maintained their attacking intensity after the break, with Deus Stanislaus and Carolina Reyna finding the net before DiMaria scored twice more to take her tally to six. Further goals from Isa Ortiz, Reyna, captain Meila Brewer and Gianna Hanf completed the rout. China PR also made an impressive start, defeating Kenya in their Group E opener. Xu Yue gave the Chinese side the lead after racing on to Fang Zhenzhu’s precise pass and finishing into the bottom-right corner. Kenya goalkeeper Mishel Okoyo kept her side in contention with a fine save to deny Wu Yichen after another incisive pass from Fang. However, China broke through again shortly after the interval when Okoyo tipped Fang’s long-range effort on to the crossbar, only for Xu Xiaotang to score from the rebound. Xu Xiaotang added her second moments later, heading home Fang’s inviting cross to complete the scoring. Spain, meanwhile, began their Group F campaign with a 2-0 victory over Mexico, last year’s bronze medallists. Mexico goalkeeper Ania Lopez produced a triple save in the 13th minute to keep her side in the contest as Spain dominated the early exchanges. Spain continued to threaten, with Elena Vizuete hitting the junction of the crossbar and post in the 28th minute. The European side eventually broke the deadlock shortly before half-time when Lopez parried Vizuete’s powerful effort into the path of Carolina Ferrera, who calmly finished into the unguarded net. Vizuete then doubled Spain’s advantage in the second half, cutting inside from the right before curling a left-footed effort beyond the goalkeeper and into the net after the ball clipped the post. The victory gave Spain a positive start as they seek to build on the success of their U-20 counterparts at the FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup. In the other Group F fixture, Australia and Chile played out a 1-1 draw. Australia created the first clear opportunity, but Chile goalkeeper Oriana Cristancho produced an excellent reaction save to keep the scores level. Chile took the lead through Concha, who headed home at the far post after Josefa Munita delivered an impressive curling cross. The Junior Matildas responded after the break, drawing level from a set-piece move. Sakura Leon delivered a low, precise cross, which Charlotte Bradshaw converted with a well-taken finish at the far post. Both teams pushed for a winner in the closing stages, but neither could find a breakthrough as they settled for a point apiece. The results marked contrasting starts to the tournament, with the USA making history, Spain and China claiming victories, and Australia and Chile sharing the spoils. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/fifa-u-17-womens-w.title_zh: FIFA U-17女足世界杯：美国以16球大胜创纪录 西班牙和中国获胜
https://leadership.ng/fifa-u-17-womens-w.body_zh: 美国队在摩洛哥2026年国际足联U-17女足世界杯上创造了新的进球纪录，他们大胜萨摩亚，而两届冠军西班牙和中国在周一的比赛中以胜利开启了各自的征程。然而，澳大利亚和智利在E组和F组开赛后经过激战以1-1战平分享了积分。美国队在国际足联世界杯历史上任何级别赛事中都取得了最大胜利，在一场一边倒的比赛中压倒萨摩亚，这场比赛也让Maddie DiMaria成为首位在U-17女足世界杯单场比赛中打进六球的球员。DiMaria在仅仅62秒后就首开纪录，侧脚将球打进，随后Mia Corona以一记精彩的角球凌空抽射将领先优势扩大到两球。DiMaria随后又快速打进两球，完成了本届赛事的首个帽子戏法，为美国队无情的表现定下了基调。Loradana Paletta梅开二度，而Grace Murray和DiMaria再进球，随后Amari Manning在远门柱处完成破门将比分扩大到九球。美国队在下半场保持了进攻强度，Deus Stanislaus和Carolina Reyna破门得分，随后DiMaria再进两球，将个人进球数提高到六球。Isa Ortiz、Reyna、队长Meila Brewer和Gianna Hanf的进一步进球完成了这场大胜。中国队也在E组首战中取得令人印象深刻的开局，击败了肯尼亚。徐悦接到方珍珠精准传球后突进，将球打入右下角取得领先。肯尼亚门将Mishel Okoyo以一次精彩扑救挡住了吴怡晨的射门，保持了本队的竞争力，此前方珍珠又一次精准传球。然而，中国队在半场休息后不久再次突破，当时Okoyo将方珍珠的远射托在横梁上，结果徐晓棠补射得分。徐晓棠随后很快再进一球，头球顶进方珍珠富有诱惑力的传中，完成了进球。与此同时，西班牙在F组以2-0战胜墨西哥（去年的铜牌得主）开启了征程。墨西哥门将Ania Lopez在第13分钟做出三次扑救，让本队继续留在比赛中，当时西班牙主导了早期的交锋。西班牙继续威胁，第28分钟Elena Vizuete的射门击中横梁和门柱的交界处。欧洲球队最终在半场结束前不久打破僵局，当时Lopez扑出了Vizuete的强力射门，球到了Carolina Ferrera的脚下，后者冷静地将球打入空门。Vizuete随后在下半场扩大了西班牙的优势，从右路内切后左脚弧线球射门，球擦过门柱越过门将入网。这场胜利让西班牙在寻求延续其U-20女足世界杯上U-20球队成功的同时有了一个积极的开端。在另一场F组比赛中，澳大利亚和智利以1-1战平。澳大利亚创造了第一个明显机会，但智利门将Oriana Cristancho做出一次精彩的反应扑救，保持了比分平衡。智利通过Concha取得领先，后者在远门柱处头球破门，此前Josefa Munita送出一次精彩的弧线传中。Junior Matildas在下半场做出回应，通过定位球配合扳平比分。Sakura Leon送出低平精准的传中，Charlotte Bradshaw在远门柱处完成精彩破门。两队在最后阶段都寻求获胜，但都没有取得突破，最终各取一分。这些结果标志着本届赛事开局的鲜明对比，美国队创造了历史，西班牙和中国取得胜利，澳大利亚和智利分享战果。我们拥有优势。获取实时报道、突发独家新闻和独家视角，直接发送到您的手机。不要满足于陈旧新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，获取24/7更新→加入我们的WhatsApp频道 突发新闻：尼日利亚人可以投资250万奈拉购买优质域名，并赚取约1700万至2500万奈拉。收益以美元计算。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/government-m.body: The government has mobilised approximately GH¢436 million for the payment of Book and Research Allowances to eligible tertiary institutions across the country, according to Hashmin Mohammed, spokesperson for the Minister of Education, Haruna Iddrisu. In a Facebook post on Monday, October 19, 2026, Mr Mohammed said GH¢238 million had already been disbursed to 56 institutions under the first batch of payments, while approximately GH¢198 million had been earmarked for the second batch. The University of Ghana is among the institutions expected to benefit from the subsequent disbursement. Mr Mohammed attributed the delay in payment to the University of Ghana to the late submission of required documentation to the Ghana Tertiary Education Commission (GTEC) for validation. He explained that the documents must be verified before the Controller and Accountant-General’s Department (CAGD) can process the payment. The spokesperson said the validation and documentation requirements form part of the administrative procedures intended to ensure that public funds are accurately processed and disbursed to the appropriate institutions. He did not indicate when the University of Ghana’s payment would be completed. The Book and Research Allowance is paid to eligible lecturers in public tertiary institutions to support their academic and research work. Delays in the payment of the allowance have periodically attracted concern from beneficiaries, making the government’s disbursement arrangements an issue of interest to tertiary education staff. With the first batch reportedly paid and the second batch earmarked for disbursement, attention will be on the completion of the outstanding administrative processes and the release of funds to the remaining eligible institutions

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 前电力和钢铁部长利耶尔·伊莫克周一表示，有争议的曼比拉水电站合同是由他的前任奥卢·阿贡洛耶在联邦执行委员会（FEC）批准下授予的。伊莫克先生于2003年7月接替阿贡洛耶先生担任电力部长，并在前总统奥卢塞贡·奥巴桑乔执政期间任职至2007年1月。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: Former Minister of Power and Steel, Liyel Imoke, said Monday that the controversial Mambilla Hydropower station contract was awarded by his predecessor Olu Agunloye with the approval of the Federal Executive Council (FEC). Mr Imoke said it was unnecessary to formally cancel the contract after he assumed office, because the contract never received the blessing of the FEC in the first place. The former Cross River State governor was fielding questions at the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Abuja, where he appeared as the sixth prosecution witness in Mr Agunloye’s corruption trial. Mr Imoke succeeded Mr Agunloye as the power minister in July 2003 and served until January 2007, during former President Olusegun Obasanjo’s administration. Mr Imoke later became the Governor of Cross River State in May 2007 and served in that capacity until May 2015. The Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) called Mr Imoke as its sixth prosecution witness against Mr Agunloye, who faces seven charges including disobedience to a presidential directive, conspiracy, forgery and receiving gratification. The charges stemmed from his roles in the award of the $6 billion Mambilla Hydroelectric Power contract in May 2003 to Sunrise Power and Transmission Company Limited (SPTCL). An arbitration panel in Paris, France, recently cleared Nigeria of any liability regarding the contract while it accused PTCL of fraud in its ….. The project was a proposed 3,050 MW hydroelectric facility located in Kakara village, Taraba State, which never saw the light of the day. The prosecution said Mr Agunloye disobeyed a presidential directive issued in 2003 during a Federal Executive Council meeting regarding the contract. The EFCC also accused Mr Agunloye of conspiring with Leno Adesanya, the major prompter of SPTCL who the agency indicated was at large, to falsify a document titled “Construction of 3,960MW Mambilla Hydroelectric Power Station on a Build, Operate and Transfer Basis” in 2003. Other allegations include receiving gratifications of over N5 million from SPTCL and Mr Adesanya. An arbitration tribunal recently exonerated Nigeria regarding the contract after finding that the award of the contract to SPTCL was tainted by bribery. Trial Judge Jude Onwuegbuzie listened on Monday as Mr Imoke, under cross-examination by Mr Agunloye’s defence lawyer Adeola Adedipe, a Senior Advocate of Nigeria (SAN), maintained that the Mambilla power station contract was null and void in the first place, and required no formal pronouncement for its cancellation. “A contract awarded in contravention of the FEC will not require cancellation,” the politician said. “I did not cancel the contract because the FEC did not approve it, and so it was null and void. The minister does not have the power to award a contract. Similarly, the Mambilla Hydroelectric Power project became a subject of international concern. The project, first awarded in 2003 to SPTCL by the President Olusegun Obasanjo administration, is the subject of decades of a legal dispute. An arbitration tribunal in Paris recently resolved the matter in favour of Nigeria and against SPTCL, which had accused Nigeria of breach of contract. Mr Obasanjo, in 2023, accused Mr Agunloye of fraudulently awarding the contract to the company without approval. However, the former minister dismissed these claims, alleging that he was being used as a scapegoat to escape sanctions by the arbitration panel in Paris for abandoning contractual agreements on the project. The project, intended to generate 3,960 megawatts of electricity, was designed to be executed on a build, operate, and transfer basis. On Monday, Mr Imoke went down the memory lane about the controversial contract. Mr Imoke, who took office as the power minister in July 2003, recalled writing a letter dated 3 September 2003 in response to SPCL’s payment inquiry about the Mambilla power contract.

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 前电力和钢铁部长利耶尔·伊莫克周一表示，有争议的曼比拉水电站合同是由他的前任奥卢·阿贡洛耶在联邦执行委员会（FEC）批准下授予的。伊莫克先生说，他上任后没有必要正式取消该合同，因为该合同一开始就没有得到联邦执行委员会（FEC）的批准。这位前克罗斯河州州长在联邦首都区（FCT）阿布贾回答问题时表示，他作为第六名检方证人出现在阿贡洛耶先生的腐败审判中。伊莫克先生于2003年7月接替阿贡洛耶先生担任电力部长，一直任职至2007年1月，当时是前总统奥卢塞贡·奥巴桑乔政府时期。伊莫克先生后来于2007年5月成为克罗斯河州州长，并担任该职务直至2015年5月。经济和金融犯罪委员会（EFCC）传唤伊莫克先生作为针对阿贡洛耶先生的第六名检方证人，阿贡洛耶面临七项指控，包括违抗总统指令、共谋、伪造和收受好处。这些指控源于他在2003年5月将60亿美元的曼比拉水电站合同授予日出电力和输电有限公司（SPTCL）中所扮演的角色。法国巴黎的一个仲裁小组最近清除了尼日利亚与该合同有关的任何责任，同时指控PTCL存在欺诈行为……该项目是一个拟建的3050兆瓦水电站，位于塔拉巴州的卡卡拉村，但从未实现。检方表示，阿贡洛耶先生违抗了2003年在联邦执行委员会会议上就该合同发布的总统指令。EFCC还指控阿贡洛耶先生与SPTCL的主要推动者莱诺·阿德萨尼亚共谋，后者被该机构指出目前在逃，于2003年伪造了一份题为“以建设、运营和转让方式建设3960兆瓦曼比拉水电站”的文件。其他指控包括从SPTCL和阿德萨尼亚先生那里收受超过500万奈拉的好处。一个仲裁法庭最近在发现将合同授予SPTCL的行为受到贿赂玷污后，就该合同免除了尼日利亚的责任。审判法官朱德·翁韦格布齐周一听取了伊莫克先生的证词，在阿贡洛耶先生的辩护律师、尼日利亚高级律师（SAN）阿德奥拉·阿德迪佩的交叉询问下，伊莫克坚持认为曼比拉电站合同从一开始就是无效的，不需要正式宣布取消。“一项违反联邦执行委员会（FEC）的合同不需要取消，”这位政治家说。“我没有取消该合同，因为联邦执行委员会（FEC）没有批准它，因此它是无效的。部长没有权力授予合同。同样，曼比拉水电站项目成为国际关注的对象。该项目于2003年首次由奥卢塞贡·奥巴桑乔政府授予SPTCL，是数十年法律纠纷的主题。巴黎的一个仲裁法庭最近解决了此事，有利于尼日利亚，不利于SPTCL，后者曾指控尼日利亚违约。奥巴桑乔先生在2023年指控阿贡洛耶先生欺诈性地在未经批准的情况下将合同授予该公司。然而，这位前部长驳斥了这些说法，声称他被当作替罪羊，以逃避巴黎仲裁小组因放弃项目合同协议而实施的制裁。该项目旨在发电3960兆瓦，设计以建设、运营和转让方式执行。周一，伊莫克先生回顾了这份有争议的合同。伊莫克先生于2003年7月就任电力部长，他回忆起写了一封日期为2003年9月3日的信，以回应SPCL关于曼比拉电力合同的付款询问。

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/n.summary_zh: 联邦政府在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴的一个大陆论坛上展示了其Renewed Hope住房公私伙伴关系（PPP）模式，吸引了希望在住房项目中复制这一举措的非洲国家的兴趣。在谈到尼日利亚的住房倡议时，Ewalefoh解释说，Renewed Hope Cities项目将通过涉及私营部门的合资特许经营，在全国选定城市交付100,000套住房单位。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/n.body: The Federal Government has showcased its Renewed Hope Housing Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model at a continental forum in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, attracting interest from African countries seeking to replicate the initiative in their housing programmes. The presentation was made by the Director-General of the Infrastructure Concession Regulatory Commission (ICRC), Dr Jobson Oseodion Ewalefoh, at the Second Forum for Public-Private Partnership Units in Africa, held at Africa Hall, United Nations Economic Commission for Africa (UNECA), with delegations from 36 countries in attendance. According to a press release issued by Ifeanyi Nwoko, ICRC Acting Head, Media and Publicity, on Monday, the forum was co-organised by the United Nations Economic Commission for Africa, the African Development Bank (AfDB) and the African Legal Support Facility under the theme, “Making Social Sector PPPs Work: From Policy Ambition to Effective Service Delivery”. The forum focused on how public-private partnerships could support the delivery of affordable housing, healthcare, education, sanitation and water services across the continent. Nigeria was among five countries that presented projects at the forum’s project clinic, alongside Malawi, Kenya, Djibouti and Côte d’Ivoire. Speaking on Nigeria’s housing initiative, Ewalefoh explained that the Renewed Hope Cities programme would deliver 100,000 housing units across selected cities in the country through a joint venture concession involving the private sector. “The beauty of this PPP structure is that it is not the conventional PPP. In this case, the private party owns the land, has the design, is financing it and is doing the construction,” he said. He explained that under President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s Renewed Hope Agenda, the government’s responsibility was to reduce the risks that could discourage private investment in housing. “The PPP here is that government agreed to de-risk the project,” Ewalefoh said. The ICRC director-general noted that commercial lending rates in Nigeria, which exceed 23 per cent, had made housing finance expensive for developers and prospective homeowners. To address the challenge, the government introduced measures to reduce investment risks and improve affordability. These include designating middle-income federal civil servants as off-takers, committing to the construction of access roads to semi-urban project sites, and providing access to concessionary financing. The Federal Mortgage Bank of Nigeria unlocked about $19 million in single-digit interest funding, while the Family Homes Fund provided a further $20 million in concessionary loans. Additionally, buyers benefit from lower mortgage rates through an approximately $112 million MOFI Real Estate Investment Fund. The government also negotiated sale prices with the developer to keep the houses affordable and imposed a limit of one housing unit per buyer to discourage speculation. According to the statement, the measures reduced the effective cost of the project by about 30 per cent. The financing arrangement enables the government to facilitate housing delivery without directly financing the construction costs. About $39 million in concessionary funding is helping to unlock a project with construction costs of approximately $125 million in private-sector investment. “Government does not need to finance housing capital projects. It can crowd in private capital through policy, land availability and off-taker facilitation to create a replicable, scalable model for housing delivery,” Ewalefoh told delegates. The model generated considerable interest during the question-and-answer session, with delegates seeking to understand how Nigeria’s risk-reduction mechanisms, particularly the off-taker guarantee and access to concessionary finance, could be adapted to their respective countries.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/n.title_zh: 尼日利亚在大陆论坛展示更新希望住房公私合作模式，吸引非洲国家复制兴趣
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/10/19/n.body_zh: 联邦政府在埃塞俄比亚亚的斯亚贝巴举行的非洲大陆论坛上展示了其复兴希望住房公私合作（PPP）模式，吸引了希望在住房项目中复制该举措的非洲国家的兴趣。基础设施特许经营监管委员会（ICRC）总干事乔布森·奥塞奥迪翁·埃瓦莱福博士在非洲联合国经济委员会（UNECA）非洲大厅举行的非洲公私合作单位第二次论坛上进行了介绍，有来自36个国家的代表团出席。根据ICRC代理媒体与宣传主管伊费安伊·恩沃科周一发布的新闻稿，该论坛由联合国非洲经济委员会、非洲开发银行（AfDB）和非洲法律支持基金共同组织，主题为“让社会部门公私合作发挥作用：从政策雄心到有效服务交付”。论坛重点讨论了公私合作如何支持在整个非洲大陆提供负担得起的住房、医疗保健、教育、卫生和供水服务。尼日利亚是五个在论坛项目诊所展示项目的国家之一，另外还有马拉维、肯尼亚、吉布提和科特迪瓦。在谈到尼日利亚的住房举措时，埃瓦莱福解释说，复兴希望城市计划将通过涉及私营部门的合资特许经营，在该国选定城市交付10万套住房单元。“这种PPP结构的优点在于它不是传统的PPP。在这种情况下，私人一方拥有土地、拥有设计、正在为其提供资金并且正在进行建设，”他说。他解释说，在博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统的复兴希望议程下，政府的责任是降低可能阻碍住房领域私人投资的风险。“这里的PPP是政府同意为项目去风险，”埃瓦莱福说。ICRC总干事指出，尼日利亚的商业贷款利率超过23%，这使得住房融资对开发商和潜在房主来说变得昂贵。为了应对这一挑战，政府采取了措施来降低投资风险并提高可负担性。这些措施包括指定中等收入联邦公务员作为承购方，承诺为半城市项目地点建设通路道路，并提供优惠融资渠道。尼日利亚联邦抵押银行解锁了约1900万美元的个位数利率资金，而家庭住房基金提供了另外2000万美元的优惠贷款。此外，买家通过约1.12亿美元的MOFI房地产投资基金获得较低的抵押贷款利率。政府还与开发商谈判销售价格以保持房屋可负担，并对每位买家限制一套住房单元以阻止投机。根据声明，这些措施将项目的有效成本降低了约30%。融资安排使政府能够在不直接资助建设成本的情况下促进住房交付。约3900万美元的优惠资金正在帮助解锁一个建设成本约为1.25亿美元的私营部门投资项目。“政府不需要为住房资本项目提供资金。它可以通过政策、土地可用性和承购方便利来吸引私人资本，从而创造一个可复制、可扩展的住房交付模式，”埃瓦莱福告诉代表们。该模式在问答环节产生了相当大的兴趣，代表们寻求了解如何将尼日利亚的风险降低机制，特别是承购方担保和优惠融资渠道，适应到他们各自的国家。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/japan-motors.body: The Ministry of Food and Agriculture has announced that Japan Motors Trading Company Limited has donated five branded motorcycles towards the 42nd National Farmers’ Day celebration. In a press release issued on Monday, October 19, 2026, the Ministry said the donation qualified the company as a silver sponsor of the annual event, which recognises the contributions of farmers and fishers to Ghana’s development. “The Ministry remains deeply grateful to the Company for its dedicated commitment to support the celebration and the promotion of agricultural development in Ghana,” the statement, signed by the Ministry’s Public Relations Unit, said. The Ministry described the donation as a recognition of the important role farmers and fishers play in national development and an example of private-sector support for agricultural promotion. It called on other corporate organisations, financial institutions, development partners and individuals to contribute towards the upcoming celebration. The Ministry said the annual event provides a national platform to recognise the hard work and achievements of farmers and fishers, whose activities are central to food security, employment and economic growth. National Farmers’ Day is an annual celebration held to honour farmers and fishers across Ghana for their contributions to agricultural production and national food security. The 42nd edition is expected to take place later this year, with corporate sponsors and other partners supporting its organisation. Japan Motors’ donation adds to the support being mobilised for the celebration as the Ministry encourages more private-sector participation

Captured in nets 
A video circulating online, reportedly showing a Nigerian soldier captured by armed bandits, raises heartbreaking questions that the Nigerian military and the Federal Government must urgently answer.

Where did this happen? When was he captured? Is he alive, and what is being done to secure his safe release?

Behind that uniform is a human being—a son, perhaps a husband, a father, and someone’s brother. A family may be waiting anxiously, praying for a loved one whose fate remains uncertain.

How can a nation ask its citizens to trust its security system when images like these leave so many questions unanswered?

https://x.com/thomasjeff007/status/21118.title: His government is sleepwalking into a serious economic crisis.
https://x.com/thomasjeff007/status/21118.snippet:
His government is sleepwalking into a serious economic crisis. The fundamental mistake was abandoning the GH¢16-to-the-dollar exchange rate he inherited and pursuing a currency policy that appears increasingly costly to sustain. He is now reportedly committing roughly $1.2 billion a month in gold-related foreign exchange interventions to keep the cedi around GH¢11 to the dollar, while the economy struggles to create jobs for an estimated 500,000 people entering the labour market every year.

What is the point of defending the cedi at such a high cost if the economy is not generating enough productive jobs, expanding exports, and building sustainable sources of foreign exchange? A stronger currency means little if it rests on costly interventions rather than stronger fundamentals.

This is precisely the kind of economic strategy that demands urgent scrutiny. The government must explain the true cost of these interventions, their sustainability, and the measurable benefits they deliver to ordinary Ghanaians. What is even more troubling is the apparent absence of an urgent push from those closest to the president for a fundamental policy reassessment. Ghana cannot afford to confuse short-term currency stability with genuine economic recovery. The country needs a credible course correction before the costs become even harder to reverse.

https://x.com/thomasjeff007/status/21118.title_zh: 他的政府正在梦游般走向严重的经济危机。
https://x.com/thomasjeff007/status/21118.snippet_zh:
他的政府正在梦游般地陷入一场严重的经济危机。根本错误在于放弃了他接手的16加纳塞地兑1美元的汇率，并推行一种似乎越来越难以维持的货币政策。据报道，他现在每月投入约12亿美元用于与黄金相关的外汇干预，以将塞地维持在约11加纳塞地兑1美元的水平，而经济却难以每年为估计50万进入劳动力市场的人创造就业机会。

如果经济没有产生足够的生产性就业、扩大出口并建立可持续的外汇来源，那么以如此高昂的代价捍卫塞地有什么意义呢？如果强势货币依赖于代价高昂的干预而不是更强的基本面，那么它就意义不大。

https://x.com/thengcorridor/status/21118.snippet:
For context..
-this policy simply means the federal government is cutting out the middleman so public universities can hire staff much faster.

BEFORE NOW, if a federal university needed to hire a lecturer or replace someone who retired, they had to apply and wait for approval from the Office of the Head of the Civil Service in Abuja. 

that clearance process, known as a waiver
...it could take months or even years, leaving many departments severely short-staffed!

Under the new arrangement...Vice-Chancellors and University Governing Councils can advertise and recruit staff directly through the Ministry of Education. 

And while this speeds up hiring and restores local control to schools, the main worry now is whether university boards will maintain strict merit or open the door to nepotism without central civil service oversight!

https://x.com/sonofchuks/status/21117662.title: You'd agree with me that the Nigeria’s security strategy looks completely different depending on which part of the country you look at, and
https://x.com/sonofchuks/status/21117662.snippet:
You'd agree with me that the Nigeria’s security strategy looks completely different depending on which part of the country you look at, and this unfairness is tearing national unity apart. 

In the South West and South South, the federal government works with local security groups and cuts deals with regional leaders to keep the peace and protect oil. 

In the North, the government uses soft approaches like rehabilitation programs to bring former bandits and insurgents back into society and recruiting them into the same Army—a move that many citizens strongly question. 

But in the South East, the strategy completely flips. Instead of cutting deals or supporting local security setups, the government relies almost entirely on heavy military force. When you combine this aggressive stance with the fact that the South East is constantly left out of key government positions, it is easy to see cordinated marginalisation. 

If the military wants everyone to trust and respect it, the government must stop treating different regions with different rules. True security can only happen when there is equal justice for all.
https://x.com/sonofchuks/status/21117662.body:
You'd agree with me that the Nigeria’s security strategy looks completely different depending on which part of the country you look at, and this unfairness is tearing national unity apart. 

In the South West and South South, the federal government works with local security groups and cuts deals with regional leaders to keep the peace and protect oil. 

In the North, the government uses soft approaches like rehabilitation programs to bring former bandits and insurgents back into society and recruiting them into the same Army—a move that many citizens strongly question. 

But in the South East, the strategy completely flips. Instead of cutting deals or supporting local security setups, the government relies almost entirely on heavy military force. When you combine this aggressive stance with the fact that the South East is constantly left out of key government positions, it is easy to see cordinated marginalisation. 

If the military wants everyone to trust and respect it, the government must stop treating different regions with different rules. True security can only happen when there is equal justice for all.
